meta.licence: free edition (Sine Nomine, DriveThruRPG); open-use terms checked in the book legal page
meta.pass: PWC37, book tier, gpt-6-luna reader, unchecked against a second reader
meta.split: tuned when sha1("settings-v1:"+id) first byte < 0x40, else held-out (GKM429)

stars-without-number.power.biopsionics.name: Biopsionics

effect.summary: Covers physical repair, bodily augmentation, and shapeshifting.

stars-without-number.power.biopsionics.blocked_reason: The described shapeshifting and bodily augmentation require changing a character’s form.

stars-without-number.power.metapsionics.name: Metapsionics

effect.summary: Nullifies, boosts, and shapes the use of other psychic abilities.

stars-without-number.power.metapsionics.blocked_reason: Its effects depend on nullifying or enhancing other powers.

stars-without-number.power.precognition.name: Precognition

effect.summary: Reads probable future events and, at advanced levels, can influence probabilities.

stars-without-number.power.precognition.cost_or_limit: Future-oriented only; readings are personal, selective, provisional, and limited in scale and detail.
stars-without-number.power.precognition.go_wrong: Present actions or chance can falsify a reading; visions may be ambiguous and misinterpreted.
stars-without-number.power.precognition.mind: Some precogs become fixed on personal interpretations of their visions.
stars-without-number.power.precognition.where_from: Achronal metadimensional energy in the psychic’s brain.
stars-without-number.power.precognition.combines: Advanced techniques can alter probability and future outcomes.
stars-without-number.power.precognition.blocked_reason: The discipline provides visions of possible future events beyond ordinary sensing.

stars-without-number.power.telekinesis.name: Telekinesis

effect.summary: Applies invisible force to move or manipulate objects, with higher skill increasing capacity.

stars-without-number.power.telekinesis.cost_or_limit: Usually needs sight or tactile contact; one object at a time until released; cannot normally move held or worn objects, unwilling intelligent targets, or the psychic’s own body.
stars-without-number.power.telekinesis.go_wrong: Force is imprecise and cannot harm living or mobile targets without further technique; kinetic effects exclude energy attacks.
stars-without-number.power.telekinesis.combines: Machines and non-sentient robots may be affected as objects.
stars-without-number.power.telekinesis.blocked_reason: The discipline includes many distinct force, defense, movement, and damage effects.

stars-without-number.power.telepathy.name: Telepathy

effect.summary: Establishes mental contact that can read thoughts and memories or support other mental techniques.

stars-without-number.power.telepathy.cost_or_limit: Normally affects intelligent biological beings, not VIs, True AIs, or other non-biological intelligences; target must be perceptible; many techniques require Effort and some permit saves.
stars-without-number.power.telepathy.go_wrong: Telepathic use may be illegal and is often difficult to prove; targets may resist advanced probes.
stars-without-number.power.telepathy.mind: Can read or affect targets’ thoughts and memories; targets usually do not notice telepathy unless suitably skilled or equipped.
stars-without-number.power.telepathy.combines: Can interact with Metapsionics and rare TL5 detection devices.
stars-without-number.power.telepathy.blocked_reason: The discipline includes direct mental access and influence that exceed the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.teleportation.name: Teleportation

effect.summary: Enables the psychic to teleport using its techniques.

stars-without-number.power.teleportation.cost_or_limit: Technique-specific Effort and skill limits apply.
stars-without-number.power.teleportation.go_wrong: Aborted unsafe jumps waste committed Effort and the action.
stars-without-number.power.teleportation.where_from: Psychic training; no specific source stated.
stars-without-number.power.teleportation.blocked_reason: The stated effects can be represented as movement and sensing.

stars-without-number.power.expert.name: Expert

effect.summary: Once per scene, reroll a failed skill check and keep the better result.

stars-without-number.power.expert.cost_or_limit: Once per scene; requires a failed skill check.
stars-without-number.power.expert.blocked_reason: A failed check can be rerolled and compared using the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.psychic.name: Psychic

effect.summary: Channels metadimensional energy into psychic feats, including telekinesis, precognition, and telepathy.

stars-without-number.power.psychic.cost_or_limit: Effort fuels abilities; maximum depends on psychic skill and the better Wisdom or Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 1.
stars-without-number.power.psychic.go_wrong: Untrained use can cause severe brain damage or madness.
stars-without-number.power.psychic.mind: The condition and training relate to psychic capability; specific mental effects are not stated.
stars-without-number.power.psychic.who_may: Psychics with the MES condition and training
stars-without-number.power.psychic.where_from: Natural MES condition and psychic training
stars-without-number.power.psychic.blocked_reason: The passage names several distinct psychic feats but does not provide their specific effects here.

stars-without-number.power.warrior.name: Warrior

effect.summary: Once per scene, negate a successful attack against you or turn your missed attack into a hit.

stars-without-number.power.warrior.cost_or_limit: Once per scene; does not apply to environmental harm, effects without attack rolls, or hits on an occupied vehicle.
stars-without-number.power.warrior.combines: May be used after the dice are rolled.
stars-without-number.power.warrior.blocked_reason: The ability changes an attack outcome, which can be resolved as a basic effect.

stars-without-number.power.partial-psych.name: Partial Psychic

effect.summary: Grants restricted use of one psychic discipline and its associated abilities.

stars-without-number.power.partial-psych.cost_or_limit: Only the chosen psychic skill can be learned or improved; Effort depends on that skill and the better Wisdom or Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 1.
stars-without-number.power.partial-psych.who_may: Adventurers choosing the Partial Psychic option
stars-without-number.power.partial-psych.combines: Can be improved through foci or advancement skill points.
stars-without-number.power.partial-psych.mechanism: Restricted psychic discipline fueled by Effort
stars-without-number.power.partial-psych.blocked_reason: The specific techniques of the chosen discipline are not described here.

stars-without-number.power.partial-warri.name: Partial Warrior

effect.summary: Adds combat aptitude, attack bonuses at specified levels, and two maximum hit points per level.

stars-without-number.power.partial-warri.cost_or_limit: Attack bonus increases at first and fifth levels; requires the Partial Warrior option.
stars-without-number.power.partial-warri.who_may: Adventurers choosing the Partial Warrior option
stars-without-number.power.partial-warri.combines: Includes a free combat focus level.
stars-without-number.power.partial-warri.blocked_reason: The stated bonuses are direct additions.

stars-without-number.power.alert.name: Alert

effect.summary: Improves awareness, prevents surprise, and grants initiative advantages.

stars-without-number.power.alert.cost_or_limit: Level 1 grants Notice; level 2 acts first unless another participant has this focus.
stars-without-number.power.alert.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.alert.combines: Level 2 benefit is contested by others with Alert.
stars-without-number.power.alert.blocked_reason: Awareness and turn-order advantages can be represented as direct bonuses and restrictions.

stars-without-number.power.armsman.name: Armsman

effect.summary: Improves melee and thrown weapon use, including damage and weapon handling.

stars-without-number.power.armsman.cost_or_limit: Does not apply to unarmed or projectile attacks; cannot combine its thrown-weapon benefits with Gunslinger.
stars-without-number.power.armsman.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.armsman.combines: Conflicts with Gunslinger for thrown weapons.
stars-without-number.power.armsman.blocked_reason: The focus requires excluding its thrown-weapon benefits when Gunslinger is also used.

stars-without-number.power.assassin.name: Assassin

effect.summary: Conceals a small weapon and supports rapid, accurate surprise attacks and movement.

stars-without-number.power.assassin.cost_or_limit: Concealed object must be no larger than a knife or pistol; movement benefit applies to Execution Attacks.
stars-without-number.power.assassin.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.assassin.combines: Uses the Execution Attack procedure; concealment defeats ordinary TL4 detection.
stars-without-number.power.assassin.blocked_reason: The stated concealment and attack benefits can be modeled as direct permissions and modifiers.

stars-without-number.power.authority.name: Authority

effect.summary: Persuades an amenable NPC to comply with a request and strengthens followers’ loyalty and performance.

stars-without-number.power.authority.cost_or_limit: Level 1 works once per day on a non-hostile NPC and cannot compel harmful or very uncharacteristic requests.
stars-without-number.power.authority.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.authority.where_from: Character focus; higher-level influence may reflect telepathy or memetic augmentation.
stars-without-number.power.authority.combines: Level 2 affects followers directly led by the character.
stars-without-number.power.authority.blocked_reason: The focus can compel NPC compliance and loyalty, an effect beyond the basic grammar.

stars-without-number.power.close-combata.name: Close Combatant

effect.summary: Reduces disadvantages and harm in close combat and improves melee fighting options.

stars-without-number.power.close-combata.cost_or_limit: Level 1 requires melee combat context; level 2 improves Shock and withdrawal actions.
stars-without-number.power.close-combata.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.close-combata.combines: Applies to pistol-sized ranged weapons used in melee.
stars-without-number.power.close-combata.blocked_reason: The effects are combat modifiers and permissions.

stars-without-number.power.connected.name: Connected

effect.summary: Provides useful contacts and occasional access to favors or acquaintances.

stars-without-number.power.connected.cost_or_limit: Level 1 requires a week in a not-entirely-hostile place and allows one favor per game day; level 2 works once per session when plausible.
stars-without-number.power.connected.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.connected.combines: The GM determines contacts and the extent of favors.
stars-without-number.power.connected.blocked_reason: The ability introduces contacts and favors rather than a mechanically unsupported effect.

stars-without-number.power.die-hard.name: Die Hard

effect.summary: Increases hit points, stabilizes severe wounds, and can avert a once-daily incapacitating injury.

stars-without-number.power.die-hard.cost_or_limit: Level 2 works once daily and cannot prevent death from Heavy weapons or similar trauma.
stars-without-number.power.die-hard.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.die-hard.combines: Level 1 hit point benefit applies retroactively.
stars-without-number.power.die-hard.mechanism: Hit point and injury prevention rules
stars-without-number.power.die-hard.blocked_reason: The health bonuses and injury prevention can be handled as direct changes to vitality.

stars-without-number.power.diplomat.name: Diplomat

effect.summary: Improves negotiation ability, language fluency, and an intelligent NPC’s reaction.

stars-without-number.power.diplomat.cost_or_limit: Reaction shift works once per session after at least thirty seconds of conversation.
stars-without-number.power.diplomat.mind: Can change an NPC’s attitude through conversation.
stars-without-number.power.diplomat.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.diplomat.combines: Improves skill checks involving diplomacy or negotiation.
stars-without-number.power.diplomat.blocked_reason: The effect alters a reaction in a limited, defined way.

stars-without-number.power.gunslinger.name: Gunslinger

effect.summary: Improves ranged weapon handling and damage, including limited damage on a miss.

stars-without-number.power.gunslinger.cost_or_limit: Reload benefit applies once per round to weapons requiring no more than a round to reload.
stars-without-number.power.gunslinger.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.gunslinger.combines: Cannot combine its thrown-weapon benefits with Armsman.
stars-without-number.power.gunslinger.blocked_reason: Thrown weapons cannot benefit from this focus and Armsman simultaneously.

stars-without-number.power.hacker.name: Hacker

effect.summary: Improves attempts to control computer systems and extends hack duration.

stars-without-number.power.hacker.cost_or_limit: Computer control lasts for a skill-dependent period; automatic failsafes eventually end control.
stars-without-number.power.hacker.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.hacker.combines: Level 2 removes the need to learn unfamiliar system protocols.
stars-without-number.power.hacker.blocked_reason: Computer control and its duration can be represented as a working alteration with a time limit.

stars-without-number.power.healer.name: Healer

effect.summary: Stabilizes wounded people and improves medical healing.

stars-without-number.power.healer.cost_or_limit: Level 1 can stabilize one adjacent mortally wounded person per round; basic first aid heals each target once daily.
stars-without-number.power.healer.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.healer.combines: Increases healing from stims and other technological devices.
stars-without-number.power.healer.blocked_reason: The effects alter vitality and stabilize injuries.

stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.name: Henchkeeper

effect.summary: Recruits willing henchmen who serve the character, with greater loyalty at the second level.

stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.cost_or_limit: Level 1 henchmen are limited by character level and normally avoid fighting; level 2 allows skilled recruits if earned through prior aid.
stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.go_wrong: Henchmen leave if clearly betrayed or placed in unacceptable danger.
stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.mind: Henchmen are loyal by inducement, devotion, or earned trust.
stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.combines: Henchmen use Peaceful Humans or Martial Humans categories.
stars-without-number.power.henchkeeper.blocked_reason: The focus establishes lasting loyalty and obedience in recruited NPCs.

stars-without-number.power.ironhide.name: Ironhide

effect.summary: Provides armor-like defense and, at higher level, immunity to unarmed and primitive attacks.

stars-without-number.power.ironhide.cost_or_limit: Does not stack with armor; Dexterity and shield modifiers still apply.
stars-without-number.power.ironhide.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.ironhide.where_from: Character focus; may arise from reflexes, luck, engineered skin, or telekinetic shielding.
stars-without-number.power.ironhide.combines: Armor benefits do not stack, but Dexterity and shield modifiers apply.
stars-without-number.power.ironhide.blocked_reason: The protection can be represented as a defensive block with stated limits.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-train.name: Psychic Training

effect.summary: Grants a psychic skill, may grant a technique, and increases Effort.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-train.cost_or_limit: Requires Psychic or Partial Psychic; a Partial Psychic is restricted to their chosen discipline.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-train.who_may: Psychics and Adventurers with Partial Psychic
stars-without-number.power.psychic-train.combines: Level 2 grants advancement points toward the selected psychic skill or its techniques.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-train.blocked_reason: The focus can grant unspecified discipline techniques whose effects are not given here.

stars-without-number.power.savage-fray.name: Savage Fray

effect.summary: Damages nearby unstruck enemies with weapon Shock and helps avoid repeated melee attacks.

stars-without-number.power.savage-fray.cost_or_limit: Shock applies only when the target’s Armor Class permits it; defensive benefit follows the first melee hit in a round.
stars-without-number.power.savage-fray.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.savage-fray.combines: Uses the character’s weapon Shock damage and melee combat context.
stars-without-number.power.savage-fray.blocked_reason: The effect is limited to direct combat damage and attack outcomes.

stars-without-number.power.shocking-assa.name: Shocking Assault

effect.summary: Improves melee Shock damage and ensures hits deal at least that much damage.

stars-without-number.power.shocking-assa.cost_or_limit: The weapon must be capable of harming the target.
stars-without-number.power.shocking-assa.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.shocking-assa.combines: Applies to melee weapons and unarmed attacks.

stars-without-number.power.sniper.name: Sniper

effect.summary: Improves Execution Attacks and increases the injury and damage caused by a successful attack.

stars-without-number.power.sniper.cost_or_limit: Applies only to Execution Attacks with a firearm or bow.
stars-without-number.power.sniper.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.sniper.combines: Uses the Execution Attack procedure and Physical saving throws.
stars-without-number.power.sniper.blocked_reason: The effects are attack and damage modifiers.

stars-without-number.power.specialist.name: Specialist

effect.summary: Improves checks in one chosen non-combat, non-psychic skill.

stars-without-number.power.specialist.cost_or_limit: Can be chosen more than once, for different skills.
stars-without-number.power.specialist.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.specialist.combines: Higher level improves the same selected skill.
stars-without-number.power.specialist.blocked_reason: The effect is a skill-check modifier.

stars-without-number.power.star-captain.name: Star Captain

effect.summary: Improves a captain’s ship combat resources, adds temporary ship hit points, and can resolve a crisis.

stars-without-number.power.star-captain.cost_or_limit: Requires the captain’s role; crisis resolution is once per engagement.
stars-without-number.power.star-captain.go_wrong: Temporary bonus hit points vanish after the fight.
stars-without-number.power.star-captain.who_may: Any character who takes this focus and captains a ship in combat
stars-without-number.power.star-captain.combines: Uses ship Command Points, ship hit points, and Crisis procedures.
stars-without-number.power.star-captain.mechanism: Ship combat bonuses and crisis resolution
stars-without-number.power.star-captain.blocked_reason: The stated effects are combat resource additions and a limited action.

stars-without-number.power.starfarer.name: Starfarer

effect.summary: Improves spike drill checks, raises the effective spike drive level, and shortens personally supervised drills.

stars-without-number.power.starfarer.cost_or_limit: Drive improvement cannot exceed drive-7; level 1 automatically succeeds only on drill checks of difficulty 10 or less.
stars-without-number.power.starfarer.who_may: Any character who takes this focus
stars-without-number.power.starfarer.combines: Applies to ships the character navigates and drills they personally oversee.
stars-without-number.power.starfarer.blocked_reason: The navigation bonuses and time reduction have defined targets and limits.

stars-without-number.power.tinker.name: Tinker

effect.summary: Improves the character’s ability to maintain and build equipment modifications.

stars-without-number.power.tinker.cost_or_limit: Mods cost half as many credits; advanced mods use one fewer pretech salvage part, to a minimum of zero.
stars-without-number.power.tinker.who_may: A character who takes the focus.
stars-without-number.power.tinker.combines: Improves Fix for building and maintaining mods.
stars-without-number.power.tinker.blocked_reason: The stated bonuses can be represented as game modifiers.

stars-without-number.power.unarmed-comba.name: Unarmed Combatant

effect.summary: Improves unarmed attacks and lets them bind opponents using long guns.

stars-without-number.power.unarmed-comba.cost_or_limit: Binding requires at least one free hand.
stars-without-number.power.unarmed-comba.who_may: A character who takes the focus.
stars-without-number.power.unarmed-comba.combines: Attack damage and Shock scale with Punch; at level 2 attacks count as TL4 weapons against advanced armor.
stars-without-number.power.unarmed-comba.blocked_reason: The attacks and their restrictions use ordinary combat resolution.

stars-without-number.power.unique-gift.name: Unique Gift

effect.summary: Provides a custom extraordinary ability or background perk selected with the GM.

stars-without-number.power.unique-gift.cost_or_limit: The GM sets what is fair; especially powerful abilities may require System Strain.
stars-without-number.power.unique-gift.who_may: A character who takes the focus, subject to GM approval.
stars-without-number.power.unique-gift.where_from: Possible technological augmentation, transhuman background, or human talent.
stars-without-number.power.unique-gift.combines: The ability is designed to fit a novel concept not covered by existing rules.
stars-without-number.power.unique-gift.blocked_reason: The passage does not specify the gift’s actual effect, so the basic effect grammar cannot resolve it.

stars-without-number.power.wanderer.name: Wanderer

effect.summary: Finds free transport for the character and a small group, and later improves travel speed.

stars-without-number.power.wanderer.cost_or_limit: Transport must run to the destination; finding it takes at most an hour and may involve illegitimate or working passage.
stars-without-number.power.wanderer.who_may: A character who takes the focus.
stars-without-number.power.wanderer.where_from: A life of travel and survival on the road.
stars-without-number.power.wanderer.combines: At level 2, travel papers can be forged, scrounged, or obtained; wanted characters may face official scrutiny.
stars-without-number.power.wanderer.mechanism: Narrative access to transport and travel documents.
stars-without-number.power.wanderer.blocked_reason: The described access and timing can be handled with ordinary scene adjudication.

stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.name: Wild Psychic Talent

effect.summary: Grants one or two limited psychic abilities chosen from a discipline.

stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.cost_or_limit: Level 1 grants one level-0 core power or a standalone level-1 technique; level 2 grants a second eligible ability and up to two Effort. The character cannot torch.
stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.go_wrong: The talent carries no stated madness or brain-damage risk.
stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.mind: No madness or brain damage from using this mild MES talent is stated.
stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.who_may: Characters other than Psychics and Partial Psychics.
stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.combines: A second pick may augment the first; it cannot exceed the specified level limits.
stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.mechanism: Restricted access to psychic techniques and Effort.
stars-without-number.power.wild-psychic-.blocked_reason: The actual effect depends on the chosen discipline ability, which is not specified by this focus alone.

stars-without-number.power.torching.name: Torching

effect.summary: Adds a free Effort point for the current scene, even beyond the normal maximum.

stars-without-number.power.torching.cost_or_limit: An Instant action, at most once per round; the user rolls for harm each time.
stars-without-number.power.torching.go_wrong: Can permanently reduce Wisdom, Constitution, or another attribute; low scores cause insanity, death, or nonviability.
stars-without-number.power.torching.mind: Wisdom damage below 3 causes violent insanity; feral psychics become psychotic and hallucinate.
stars-without-number.power.torching.who_may: Psychics; all power use by untrained MES subjects counts as torching.
stars-without-number.power.torching.where_from: Deliberately bypassing psychic safety and neural refractory limits.
stars-without-number.power.torching.combines: Feral psychics can torch without further harm and have effectively unlimited Effort for acquired powers.
stars-without-number.power.torching.blocked_reason: Torching can inflict permanent attribute damage and irreversible insanity or death.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-succo.name: Psychic Succor

effect.summary: Stabilizes a critically wounded target and, at higher skill, restores hit points.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-succo.cost_or_limit: Adds one System Strain, or two for a mortally wounded target. Commit Effort for the day to activate it, then reuse it in that scene without another commitment. At level 0 it must be used within six rounds of collapse.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-succo.go_wrong: Does not work on a decapitated target or one killed by Heavy weapons unless a later technique permits stabilization.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-succo.combines: Improves with Biopsionics skill; Mastered Succor removes its ordinary Effort cost.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-succo.blocked_reason: The stated touch, timing, healing, and resource limits are directly actionable.

stars-without-number.power.mastered-succ.name: Mastered Succor

effect.summary: Removes Psychic Succor’s ordinary Effort requirement.

stars-without-number.power.mastered-succ.cost_or_limit: Augmenting techniques may still require Effort.
stars-without-number.power.mastered-succ.combines: Affects Psychic Succor; it can be selected as a standalone Wild Psychic Talent only if its prerequisites are met.
stars-without-number.power.mastered-succ.mechanism: Removes resource cost from a power.
stars-without-number.power.mastered-succ.blocked_reason: The technique changes another power’s activation cost and must be applied as a power modifier.

stars-without-number.power.organic-purif.name: Organic Purification Protocols

effect.summary: Uses Psychic Succor to cure a target’s poisons or diseases.

stars-without-number.power.organic-purif.cost_or_limit: Requires an additional Effort committed for the day; tough infections or TL5 toxins require a Wisdom/Biopsionics check, difficulty at least 10. Cannot cure congenital illness.
stars-without-number.power.organic-purif.go_wrong: A failed resistance check prevents curing the target’s disease.
stars-without-number.power.organic-purif.combines: Augments Psychic Succor; interacts with resistant pathogens and toxins.
stars-without-number.power.organic-purif.blocked_reason: The ability augments the effect of Psychic Succor and includes a separate resistance check.

stars-without-number.power.remote-repair.name: Remote Repair

effect.summary: Allows touch-based biopsionic techniques, including Psychic Succor, to work at range.

stars-without-number.power.remote-repair.cost_or_limit: Target must be visible unaided and within 100 meters; commit Effort for the scene each use.
stars-without-number.power.remote-repair.go_wrong: Hostile effects that normally need a hit roll instead hit automatically.
stars-without-number.power.remote-repair.combines: Extends other normally touch-based biopsionic techniques.
stars-without-number.power.remote-repair.mechanism: Changes a power’s range and hit resolution.
stars-without-number.power.remote-repair.blocked_reason: It modifies the range and accuracy of other powers.

stars-without-number.power.invincible-st.name: Invincible Stand

effect.summary: Keeps a target active at zero hit points while the psychic renews the effect each round.

stars-without-number.power.invincible-st.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene each round; damage requires an additional Instant commitment or the target immediately suffers a mortal wound.
stars-without-number.power.invincible-st.go_wrong: Heavy-weapon hits or physical dismemberment always kill the target.
stars-without-number.power.invincible-st.where_from: Emergency tissue reinforcement and system stabilization.
stars-without-number.power.invincible-st.combines: Can affect the psychic or a touched target.
stars-without-number.power.invincible-st.blocked_reason: The effect depends on repeated activation and a conditional response to incoming damage.

stars-without-number.power.major-organ-r.name: Major Organ Restoration

effect.summary: Extends Psychic Succor to cure congenital defects and regrow limbs or organs, and permits stabilization after extreme injury.

stars-without-number.power.major-organ-r.cost_or_limit: For severe dismemberment, use within one round per Biopsionics level; further healing requires 24 hours of rest.
stars-without-number.power.major-organ-r.go_wrong: Severely damaged targets can only be stabilized at first.
stars-without-number.power.major-organ-r.blocked_reason: Regrowing organs and limbs requires bodily form reconstruction beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.tissue-integr.name: Tissue Integrity Field

effect.summary: Extends Psychic Succor to allies within ten meters of its target.

stars-without-number.power.tissue-integr.cost_or_limit: Allies may refuse healing; each use costs an extra Effort for the day in addition to Psychic Succor.
stars-without-number.power.tissue-integr.combines: Augments Psychic Succor and adds System Strain to treated allies as usual.
stars-without-number.power.tissue-integr.blocked_reason: It expands another power’s targets and carries that power’s costs.

stars-without-number.power.accelerated-s.name: Accelerated Succor

effect.summary: Speeds Psychic Succor to an On Turn action, or an Instant action with extra Effort.

stars-without-number.power.accelerated-s.cost_or_limit: Normally usable once per round; Instant use costs an additional Effort for the day.
stars-without-number.power.accelerated-s.combines: Other Succor surcharges, such as Tissue Integrity Field, still apply.
stars-without-number.power.accelerated-s.blocked_reason: It alters the activation timing and cost of Psychic Succor.

stars-without-number.power.metamorph.name: Metamorph

effect.summary: Reshapes the user or a willing target into a humanoid form within half to one-and-a-half times the user’s mass.

stars-without-number.power.metamorph.cost_or_limit: Requires a touched willing target and Effort committed for the transformation’s duration; another target reverts if the psychic moves more than 100 kilometers away.
stars-without-number.power.metamorph.go_wrong: Flight is beyond the technique’s scope; environmental changes are GM-limited.
stars-without-number.power.metamorph.who_may: Biopsions who learn the technique; the target must be willing if not the psychic.
stars-without-number.power.metamorph.combines: Can create weapon-equivalent claws, AC 13 armor, gills, or other permitted changes; DNA-level impersonation requires a sample and adds unrecoverable System Strain while changed.
stars-without-number.power.metamorph.blocked_reason: The technique changes a person’s body, including anatomy and DNA, which the basic effect grammar cannot represent.

stars-without-number.power.teratic-overl.name: Teratic Overload

effect.summary: Inflicts damage and may cause a lethal cancer that kills in 1d6 months.

stars-without-number.power.teratic-overl.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene; the target saves against the attack. The target can be affected only once per scene. A day-long commitment can instead create subtle, damage-free tumors.
stars-without-number.power.teratic-overl.go_wrong: Failure on the save triples damage and causes lethal cancer; timely TL4 treatment may cure it.
stars-without-number.power.teratic-overl.combines: A TL4 hospital or ship’s sick bay can treat the cancer if managed within a month.
stars-without-number.power.teratic-overl.blocked_reason: The delayed cancer, chance of onset, and medical remedy require lasting harmful-state tracking.

stars-without-number.power.holistic-opti.name: Holistic Optimization Patterning

effect.summary: Boosts Strength or Dexterity checks, attacks, damage, and hit points for the rest of the scene.

stars-without-number.power.holistic-opti.cost_or_limit: On Turn action; adds two System Strain; grants +2 bonuses and 20 temporary hit points. Commit Effort for the day; a target can be affected only once per scene.
stars-without-number.power.holistic-opti.go_wrong: Bonuses and excess temporary hit points expire at scene end; damage comes off temporary hit points first.
stars-without-number.power.holistic-opti.who_may: Biopsions who learn the technique; may affect self or a touched ally.
stars-without-number.power.holistic-opti.combines: Temporary hit points are lost before ordinary hit points.
stars-without-number.power.holistic-opti.blocked_reason: It combines temporary hit points, skill bonuses, attack bonuses, and damage bonuses in one timed augmentation.

stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.name: Quintessential Reconstruction

effect.summary: Regenerates the psychic from the largest remaining body fragment over 24 hours after death.

stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.cost_or_limit: Each use permanently reduces one chosen attribute by one; regeneration maximizes System Strain for a week. Reaching zero hit points during that week causes permanent death; regeneration may be postponed up to a week.
stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.go_wrong: A second death during the recovery week is permanent; burial or confinement may make the revived psychic’s life short.
stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.mind: The psychic retains vague awareness while dead.
stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.where_from: A MES-energy pattern linked to the psychic’s realspace coordinates.
stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.combines: Can be delayed to avoid detection; requires a surviving body fragment.
stars-without-number.power.quintessentia.blocked_reason: It specifies awareness after death, delayed regeneration, body-fragment persistence, and permanent-death conditions.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-refin.name: Psychic Refinement

effect.summary: Detects psychic power use, identifies psychics, improves saves, raises Effort capacity, and permits safer torching at higher levels.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-refin.cost_or_limit: Level-dependent; at level 4 torching causes 10 damage after the power activates, recoverable only by natural bed rest.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-refin.go_wrong: Torching damage can reduce the adept to zero hit points.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-refin.combines: Can detect powers and psychics; level-4 torching may be stabilized if it drops the adept to zero hit points.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-refin.blocked_reason: It combines detection, saving-throw bonuses, Effort capacity, and a special torching cost beyond one basic effect.

stars-without-number.power.cloak-powers.name: Cloak Powers

effect.summary: Hides the adept’s psychic abilities from metapsionic detection.

stars-without-number.power.cloak-powers.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for as long as the cloak is maintained; equal- or higher-skilled metapsions can contest detection.
stars-without-number.power.cloak-powers.go_wrong: An investigator can pierce the cloak with a successful opposed test.
stars-without-number.power.cloak-powers.blocked_reason: Concealment of the adept’s psychic abilities fits the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.mindtracing.name: Mindtracing

effect.summary: Shares the senses of a psychic whose power use the adept noticed, and reveals their location.

stars-without-number.power.mindtracing.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene; lasts one round.
stars-without-number.power.mindtracing.who_may: Metapsionics adepts who noticed psychic power use.
stars-without-number.power.mindtracing.combines: Treats the traced user as visible for the adept’s other abilities; can reveal a teleporter’s destination view or a biopsion behind a changed form.
stars-without-number.power.mindtracing.blocked_reason: Tracing a power user’s location and viewing through their senses requires remote detection.

stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.name: Synthetic Adaptation

effect.summary: Enables Telepathy or Biopsion powers to affect an intelligent machine.

stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.cost_or_limit: Requires Program-0 or Fix-0; only intelligent machines qualify; the adept pays any System Strain caused.
stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.go_wrong: The adept, rather than the machine, suffers the power’s System Strain.
stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.who_may: Metapsionics adepts with Program-0 or Fix-0.
stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.where_from: Synergy with the quantum intelligence of a VI or True AI.
stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.combines: Extends Telepathy or Biopsion powers to intelligent machines.
stars-without-number.power.synthetic-ada.blocked_reason: It modifies which targets other powers can affect and reallocates their System Strain cost.

stars-without-number.power.neural-trap.name: Neural Trap

effect.summary: After accepting a hostile save-enabled power, makes the adept’s next power against that attacker unresistible.

stars-without-number.power.neural-trap.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort; lasts until the adept attacks or reclaims it; only one trap per attacker from a given psychic.
stars-without-number.power.neural-trap.go_wrong: The adept voluntarily fails the initial saving throw and accepts the hostile effect.
stars-without-number.power.neural-trap.who_may: Metapsionics adepts targeted by a hostile power that allows a save.
stars-without-number.power.neural-trap.combines: The next psychic power aimed at the assailant allows no save.
stars-without-number.power.neural-trap.blocked_reason: It changes the saving-throw rules of a later power against a specific attacker.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-stati.name: Psychic Static

effect.summary: Counters a perceived psychic power unless its user spends Effort to resist.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-stati.cost_or_limit: Both sides may repeatedly spend Effort for the day until one stops or runs out; usable once per round against a given power.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-stati.go_wrong: The target power’s user can counter-spend Effort to resist; the interference reveals the adept’s position to that target.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-stati.blocked_reason: It negates an active power through an opposed expenditure of Effort.

stars-without-number.power.suspended-man.name: Suspended Manifestation

effect.summary: Stores one prepared psychic power in a self-sustaining loop for later release.

stars-without-number.power.suspended-man.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day plus the power’s normal activation Effort; held Effort cannot recover until release; only one power at a time.
stars-without-number.power.suspended-man.combines: Releases the suspended power later as an Instant action, or On Turn if it permits a save.
stars-without-number.power.suspended-man.blocked_reason: It stores a power in the adept and preserves committed expenditure until that power is released.

stars-without-number.power.concert-of-mi.name: Concert of Minds

effect.summary: Lets willing psychics share access to one another’s powers and techniques.

stars-without-number.power.concert-of-mi.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort; participants must be willing and within three meters initially, with one additional participant per Metapsionics skill level; extra Effort is needed after shared use in a round.
stars-without-number.power.concert-of-mi.go_wrong: The gestalt drops if the metapsion fails to pay the required scene Effort; it cannot be reformed for that scene.
stars-without-number.power.concert-of-mi.mind: Does not share thoughts or senses.
stars-without-number.power.concert-of-mi.combines: Members use others’ abilities with their own Effort and the original user’s skill level.
stars-without-number.power.concert-of-mi.blocked_reason: It grants participants access to one another’s held powers and techniques.

stars-without-number.power.metadimension.name: Metadimensional Friction

effect.summary: Makes a visible psychic suffer damage whenever they spend Effort or initiate a power.

stars-without-number.power.metadimension.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene; target must be visible and within 200 meters; ends by scene’s end at latest; only one application per target.
stars-without-number.power.metadimension.go_wrong: The target can attempt a Mental save each time damage is suffered to end the effect.
stars-without-number.power.metadimension.combines: Triggers on Effort commitment or NPC power initiation.
stars-without-number.power.metadimension.blocked_reason: It inflicts recurring damage in response to the target’s later actions.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.name: Psychic Tutelage

effect.summary: Trains potential psychics to control their emerging abilities and avoid accidental activation.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.cost_or_limit: Skill 3 can train ten pupils at once; skill 4 can train one hundred; initial safety training takes a week, while effective training takes one to four years.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.go_wrong: Without the safety technique, converting latent potential into a trained psychic is nearly impossible and may cause permanent brain damage.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.mind: Develops control over emerging psychic abilities.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.who_may: Metapsionics adepts skilled enough to train pupils; pupils need latent potential.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.where_from: Metadimensional energy modulation and psychic instruction.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.combines: Other psychics may assist with effective training.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-tutel.blocked_reason: The technique teaches and develops another person’s psychic abilities over time.

stars-without-number.power.surge-momentu.name: Surge Momentum

effect.summary: Weakens targets’ saves against a power, with weaker targets automatically failing.

stars-without-number.power.surge-momentu.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day when using a power that grants a saving throw; automatic failure applies to targets below half the adept’s level threshold.
stars-without-number.power.surge-momentu.where_from: Metadimensional energy reinforcing the adept’s will.
stars-without-number.power.surge-momentu.blocked_reason: It modifies the save and outcome of another power.

stars-without-number.power.flawless-mast.name: Flawless Mastery

effect.summary: Removes Effort costs from one chosen technique the adept knows.

stars-without-number.power.flawless-mast.cost_or_limit: Choose one technique; can be learned once; changing the choice requires a month of practice.
stars-without-number.power.flawless-mast.who_may: Metapsionics adepts who know another discipline’s technique.
stars-without-number.power.flawless-mast.combines: Other techniques augmenting the mastered technique may still cost Effort.
stars-without-number.power.flawless-mast.blocked_reason: It changes the activation costs and potentially the duration of another technique.

stars-without-number.power.impervious-pa.name: Impervious Pavis of Will

effect.summary: Makes the adept an invalid target for unwanted powers from a chosen discipline.

stars-without-number.power.impervious-pa.cost_or_limit: Choose a discipline; Effort for the day extends the immunity to allies within 50 meters for a scene; may be learned multiple times.
stars-without-number.power.impervious-pa.combines: Shared protection covers every discipline the adept has chosen to negate.
stars-without-number.power.impervious-pa.blocked_reason: It makes the adept and allies immune to an entire category of powers.

stars-without-number.power.oracle.name: Oracle

effect.summary: Gives a brief, personal-vantage vision relevant to a question about the future.

stars-without-number.power.oracle.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the day; one brief vision with a maximum insight of one minute; the same question cannot be asked again until circumstances substantially change or a week passes; horizon scales from a minute to a year by skill.
stars-without-number.power.oracle.go_wrong: Visions may omit delayed consequences, be ambiguous, or be overturned by events.
stars-without-number.power.oracle.combines: Answers concern actions and events, not abstract facts.
stars-without-number.power.oracle.blocked_reason: It supplies information about possible future events.

stars-without-number.power.intuitive-res.name: Intuitive Response

effect.summary: Gives the precog superior initiative in a coming combat.

stars-without-number.power.intuitive-res.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene just before initiative; cannot be used if surprised.
stars-without-number.power.intuitive-res.go_wrong: If another participant has automatic initiative success, normal initiative determines which acts first.
stars-without-number.power.intuitive-res.blocked_reason: It changes turn order rather than an effect represented by the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.sense-the-nee.name: Sense the Need

effect.summary: Retroactively establishes that the psychic brought a plausible needed object.

stars-without-number.power.sense-the-nee.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day; the object must have been reasonably obtainable, carried, and plausible given events.
stars-without-number.power.sense-the-nee.go_wrong: The declared object may be rejected as implausible, such as after a search or weapons check.
stars-without-number.power.sense-the-nee.where_from: A vague premonition in the recent past.
stars-without-number.power.sense-the-nee.blocked_reason: It retroactively adds an object to the character’s carried inventory.

stars-without-number.power.terminal-refl.name: Terminal Reflection

effect.summary: Warns the precog of an imminent unexpected hazard, preventing a trap from springing or combat surprise.

stars-without-number.power.terminal-refl.cost_or_limit: If Effort for the day is not committed immediately, the sense goes numb for the rest of the day.
stars-without-number.power.terminal-refl.go_wrong: Requires immediate Effort payment to remain usable that day.
stars-without-number.power.terminal-refl.combines: Can protect companions from combat surprise.
stars-without-number.power.terminal-refl.blocked_reason: It produces a triggered vision of imminent danger.

stars-without-number.power.alternate-out.name: Alternate Outcome

effect.summary: Lets the psychic or a visible ally reroll a failed roll and keep the better result.

stars-without-number.power.alternate-out.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day; each target can benefit once per day.
stars-without-number.power.alternate-out.who_may: Precognition adepts; target is self or a visible ally.
stars-without-number.power.alternate-out.combines: Applies to a failed hit roll, save, or skill check.
stars-without-number.power.alternate-out.blocked_reason: It rewrites an already resolved random result.

stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.name: Destiny’s Shield

effect.summary: Forces an attacker to reroll a successful attack against the precog.

stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day; works only against attacks on the psychic and once per incoming attack.
stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.go_wrong: If the reroll still hits, damage is maximized.
stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.who_may: Precognition adepts targeted by an attack roll.
stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.where_from: Observation of an incoming injury and an alternate future.
stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.combines: Can alter an attack roll against the psychic, not vehicle attacks or harm without an attack roll.
stars-without-number.power.destiny-s-shi.blocked_reason: It rewrites an already successful attack roll and changes the consequences of a second result.

stars-without-number.power.anguished-vis.name: Anguished Vision

effect.summary: Rewinds the current combat round or the last six seconds to reveal the immediate future as a vision.

stars-without-number.power.anguished-vis.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day; usable once per day.
stars-without-number.power.anguished-vis.combines: Nothing in the rewound interval actually happened.
stars-without-number.power.anguished-vis.blocked_reason: It reverses elapsed time and negates events that occurred.

stars-without-number.power.cursed-luck.name: Cursed Luck

effect.summary: Forces an animate target to take the worse of paired rolls while attacks against it take better results.

stars-without-number.power.cursed-luck.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the scene; visible animate target, not a vehicle; one application per target.
stars-without-number.power.cursed-luck.go_wrong: Intelligent targets may attempt a Mental save each round to end the effect.
stars-without-number.power.cursed-luck.where_from: Negative probabilities woven around the target.
stars-without-number.power.cursed-luck.combines: Affects the target’s attacks, damage, checks, and saves, as well as attempts to hit or damage it.
stars-without-number.power.cursed-luck.blocked_reason: It persistently alters multiple future rolls and requires asymmetric roll selection.

stars-without-number.power.forced-outcom.name: Forced Outcome

effect.summary: Controls simple random mechanical outcomes and can cause plausible coincidences nearby.

stars-without-number.power.forced-outcom.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the scene; more than one unusual chance per scene is likely impossible; GM judges plausibility.
stars-without-number.power.forced-outcom.go_wrong: Outcomes requiring human involvement or affecting many objects are outside the stated scope.
stars-without-number.power.forced-outcom.combines: Examples include a roulette result or shuffled-card order.

stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.name: Not My Time

effect.summary: Automatically causes improbable events to keep the precog alive when death is imminent.

stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.cost_or_limit: Requires Effort for the day; at most once per week; protection lasts at least a few minutes if the precog avoids renewed danger.
stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.go_wrong: Survival does not ensure the precog remains physically or mentally intact.
stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.mind: May leave the precog mentally harmed.
stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.who_may: Precognition adepts able to commit Effort.
stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.where_from: Probability pulled away from futures in which the psychic dies.
stars-without-number.power.not-my-time.blocked_reason: It guarantees survival by causing unspecified external events and consequences.

stars-without-number.power.prophecy.name: Prophecy

effect.summary: Makes one prediction about the psychic’s personal future come true if conditions are met.

stars-without-number.power.prophecy.cost_or_limit: Main Action and committed Effort until fulfilment or abandonment; once per month and only one active prophecy; requires reasonable measures, no direct enemy resistance, and a plausible prediction.
stars-without-number.power.prophecy.go_wrong: A prophecy fails if the conditions are not satisfied or the GM judges it highly improbable.
stars-without-number.power.prophecy.blocked_reason: It establishes and guarantees a future outcome subject to narrative conditions.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-m.name: Telekinetic Manipulation

effect.summary: Moves or manipulates objects with telekinetic force; at higher levels can affect multiple objects or break barriers.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-m.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene as a Main Action; visible range or tactile contact; objects move 20 meters per round; level-based weight and object limits; moving force can be maintained but only one activation at a time.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-m.go_wrong: Cannot damage living or mobile targets; harm to immobile unliving objects requires focused force and deals damage per round.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-m.combines: Can hold objects in place; higher skill allows stronger or multiple-object manipulation.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-m.blocked_reason: The technique covers movement, restraint, and object damage with skill-dependent capacities.

stars-without-number.power.kinetic-trans.name: Kinetic Transversal

effect.summary: Allows movement over vertical and overhead surfaces and across liquids.

stars-without-number.power.kinetic-trans.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort; solid surfaces must bear five kilograms; lasts while Effort remains committed.
stars-without-number.power.kinetic-trans.blocked_reason: Movement over surfaces and liquids fits the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.pressure-fiel.name: Pressure Field

effect.summary: Creates a protective personal field that maintains pressure and temperature and filters hazards.

stars-without-number.power.pressure-fiel.cost_or_limit: Instant action; Effort for the scene protects up to six companions; lasts until Effort is reclaimed; tolerates temperatures within 100°C above or below ordinary conditions.
stars-without-number.power.pressure-fiel.who_may: Telekinesis adepts; companions may be included.
stars-without-number.power.pressure-fiel.combines: Can support orbital insertion when paired with Telekinetic Flight.
stars-without-number.power.pressure-fiel.blocked_reason: It creates an ongoing protective environmental field around multiple people.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-a.name: Telekinetic Armory

effect.summary: Creates force weapons and armor for the psychic.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-a.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort; gear remains while Effort is committed; armor gives AC 15 plus skill and does not stack with conventional armor.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-a.combines: Weapons act like TL4 rifles or advanced melee weapons; armor can be modified by Dexterity or shields.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-a.blocked_reason: It creates functional weapons and armor whose existence depends on committed Effort.

stars-without-number.power.impact-sump.name: Impact Sump

effect.summary: Negates one instance of physical damage.

stars-without-number.power.impact-sump.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day; only once per day; can be triggered after damage is rolled.
stars-without-number.power.impact-sump.blocked_reason: It blocks one instance of physical damage.

stars-without-number.power.slip-field.name: Slip Field

effect.summary: Reduces friction in a ten-meter area, making movement difficult and potentially knocking targets prone.

stars-without-number.power.slip-field.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the scene; affects up to ten meters in diameter; vehicle drivers face a skill test; saved targets are immune for the scene.
stars-without-number.power.slip-field.go_wrong: A failing vehicle driver goes out of control and may crash into obstacles.
stars-without-number.power.slip-field.combines: Can affect selected targets or a ground vehicle.
stars-without-number.power.slip-field.blocked_reason: It creates a persistent area effect that constrains multiple targets’ movement.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-e.name: Telekinetic Expertise

effect.summary: Removes the Effort cost from Telekinetic Manipulation.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-e.cost_or_limit: Requires Telekinesis-2; applies to Telekinetic Manipulation.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-e.blocked_reason: It changes the activation cost of another technique.

stars-without-number.power.thermokinesis.name: Thermokinesis

effect.summary: Heats or chills an inanimate object enough to melt, ignite, or freeze it.

stars-without-number.power.thermokinesis.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the scene; target must be small enough for the adept to lift; held or used objects are unaffected.
stars-without-number.power.thermokinesis.go_wrong: Non-sentient robots and other objects with hit points suffer damage from each application.
stars-without-number.power.thermokinesis.combines: Can affect non-sentient robots; does not affect objects held or used by intelligent creatures.
stars-without-number.power.thermokinesis.blocked_reason: It changes an object’s temperature and material state rather than only moving or damaging it.

stars-without-number.power.tangible-forc.name: Tangible Force Construct

effect.summary: Creates a shaped, sturdy force construct at a visible point.

stars-without-number.power.tangible-forc.cost_or_limit: Once per turn; Commit Effort for the scene; fits within a three-meter cube; ends at scene end, on dismissal, or after 20 damage against AC 15.
stars-without-number.power.tangible-forc.go_wrong: Can be smashed by sufficient damage.
stars-without-number.power.tangible-forc.combines: May be visible or invisible and can remain unsupported.
stars-without-number.power.tangible-forc.blocked_reason: It creates a persistent, destructible object from a power.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-r.name: Telekinetic Ram

effect.summary: Detonates a powerful delayed burst of force against an immobile target.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-r.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the scene; detonates at the end of the next round; target must remain entirely immobile.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-r.go_wrong: Any target movement disrupts the ram; targets can sense its warning.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-r.combines: Can destroy a civilian vehicle, breach ordinary barriers, or deal heavy-weapon damage.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-r.blocked_reason: It has delayed detonation, a movement-sensitive trigger, and several distinct damage and destruction outcomes.

stars-without-number.power.reactive-tele.name: Reactive Telekinesis

effect.summary: Reflects a missed physical attack back toward its attacker.

stars-without-number.power.reactive-tele.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the scene when an assailant misses with a physical attack.
stars-without-number.power.reactive-tele.go_wrong: The attacker rerolls against themselves twice; a hit causes their own attack’s damage, maximized if both hit.
stars-without-number.power.reactive-tele.who_may: Telekinesis adepts attacked by physical means.
stars-without-number.power.reactive-tele.combines: Triggers only after an attacker misses the psychic.
stars-without-number.power.reactive-tele.blocked_reason: It redirects and re-resolves another creature’s attack.

stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.name: Force Puppetry

effect.summary: Takes control of a visible target’s physical movement, including a person, robot, or vehicle.

stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the day; target no larger than a ground car; lasts until scene end, loss of sight, or a sapient target believes it faces lethal danger.
stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.go_wrong: A sapient target can resist with a Mental save; control ends under the stated danger condition.
stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.mind: Overrides physical action but cannot control speech; can keep a target silent.
stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.who_may: Telekinesis adepts; targets may be robotic, vehicular, or human.
stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.combines: Controlled attacks and checks use the psychic’s skill and hit bonus.
stars-without-number.power.force-puppetr.blocked_reason: It imposes direct control over a sapient target’s physical actions.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-f.name: Telekinetic Flight

effect.summary: Lets the psychic fly and optionally carries nearby unresisting allies.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-f.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort; allies must be human-sized, unresisting, within 30 meters, and remain close at turn end; lasts while Effort remains committed.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-f.go_wrong: None stated; orbital insertion requires a vacc suit or Pressure Field.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-f.who_may: Telekinesis adepts and up to six nearby unresisting allies.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-f.combines: Can negate falling damage and can be combined with Pressure Field for orbital insertion.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic-f.blocked_reason: Flight and carrying willing passengers fit the basic movement effect.

stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.name: Telepathic Contact

effect.summary: Opens mental contact for emotional impressions, language, thoughts, or memories depending on skill.

stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the day; lasts at most a scene; target must be perceptible; advanced probes allow a Mental save and a successful save blocks further save-enabled forms for the scene.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.go_wrong: A successful save resists the applicable probe and can end contact; memory probes end contact regardless of the save.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.mind: Reads emotions, language, surface thoughts, or memories.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.who_may: Telepathy adepts; target must be sentient and normally biological.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.combines: Provides the link used by several other Telepathy techniques.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-co.blocked_reason: It directly accesses another being’s thoughts, language, and memories.

stars-without-number.power.facile-mind.name: Facile Mind

effect.summary: Reduces the Effort and action cost of opening Telepathic Contact.

stars-without-number.power.facile-mind.cost_or_limit: Scene Effort instead of day Effort; a practiced ally may be contacted without Effort; day Effort allows Instant activation.
stars-without-number.power.facile-mind.who_may: Telepathy adepts; no-Effort contact requires an ally who practiced with the psychic for at least a week.
stars-without-number.power.facile-mind.blocked_reason: It changes another technique’s activation cost and action timing.

stars-without-number.power.transmit-thou.name: Transmit Thought

effect.summary: Sends thoughts and images through a Telepathic Contact for two-way communication.

stars-without-number.power.transmit-thou.cost_or_limit: Requires an existing contact; willing target for two-way communication.
stars-without-number.power.transmit-thou.blocked_reason: Sending thoughts through an established link fits the basic information-transfer effect.

stars-without-number.power.far-thought.name: Far Thought

effect.summary: Maintains a distant connection to a previously contacted target.

stars-without-number.power.far-thought.cost_or_limit: Requires an earlier Telepathic Contact; range rises from 100 kilometers to planetary and orbital distance with skill; distant contact cannot carry save-enabled techniques.
stars-without-number.power.far-thought.go_wrong: The distant connection is tenuous and cannot support resistible techniques.
stars-without-number.power.far-thought.mind: Maintains telepathic contact at a distance.
stars-without-number.power.far-thought.who_may: Telepathy adepts who previously contacted the target.
stars-without-number.power.far-thought.combines: Permits other techniques only when they do not allow the target a saving throw.
stars-without-number.power.far-thought.blocked_reason: It establishes and maintains a remote mental link to another being.

stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.name: Suppress Cognition

effect.summary: Makes a contacted target unable to think about one selected thought or person.

stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the scene; target gets a Mental save and immunity for the scene on success; effect otherwise lasts the scene.
stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.go_wrong: Physical danger or a traumatic threat dissolves the block and prevents reapplication that scene.
stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.mind: Suppresses a specified thought; target generally remains unaware of the temporary fugue afterward.
stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.who_may: Telepathy adepts with an active contact.
stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.combines: The chosen subject may be an action, the telepath’s presence, a person, or another single idea.
stars-without-number.power.suppress-cogn.blocked_reason: It directly blocks a target’s thoughts and cognition.

stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.name: Reflex Response

effect.summary: Implants an impulse that makes a contacted target use their next action to carry it out.

stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the day; target may attempt a Mental save.
stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.go_wrong: Cannot compel self-harm or harm to a loved one; a successful save resists.
stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.mind: Creates an irrational impulse the target may rationalize as their own choice.
stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.who_may: Telepathy adepts with an active contact.
stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.combines: The target acts to the best of their ability on their next available action.
stars-without-number.power.reflex-respon.blocked_reason: It imposes an impulse on another person’s mind and behavior.

stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.name: Telepathic Assault

effect.summary: Deals mental damage to a contacted target and may render them unconscious.

stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the day; damage is 6d6 or 9d6 at Telepathy-4; one assault per target per scene; cannot kill.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.go_wrong: Target may save to halve damage; at zero hit points they wake after an hour with one hit point.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.mind: Victim may be knocked unconscious for an hour.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.where_from: Metadimensional energy forced through the target’s brain.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.combines: Uses Telepathic Contact; target may make a Mental save.
stars-without-number.power.telepathic-as.blocked_reason: It deals damage with a defined nonlethal outcome.

stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.name: Memory Editing

effect.summary: Erases, changes, or adds simple memories covering up to a day of events.

stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.cost_or_limit: Main Action and Effort for the day; requires current Telepathic Contact; target may save during the rest of the scene; edits may be poor if the psychic lacks understanding.
stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.go_wrong: Unfamiliar memories may be edited inconsistently; a successful save resists; changed memories may be noticed if the target is given reason to recall them.
stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.who_may: Telepathy adepts with a current contact.
stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.where_from: Telepathic access to the target’s memories.
stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.combines: Level-4 Telepathic Contact can provide fuller understanding before editing.
stars-without-number.power.memory-editin.blocked_reason: It directly alters another being’s stored memories.

stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.name: Unity of Thought

effect.summary: Links up to six willing participants for shallow mental communication, shared awareness, and coordinated action.

stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.cost_or_limit: Requires a Telepathic Contact with a willing ally; up to six participants; link lasts until the psychic initiates another contact and reaches across a solar system.
stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.go_wrong: The link ends when the psychic starts a new Telepathic Contact.
stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.mind: Shares thoughts, images, and sensory impressions; each participant knows the others’ location and condition.
stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.who_may: Telepathy adepts and up to six willing participants.
stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.where_from: A Telepathic Contact with a willing ally.
stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.combines: Shares best initiative and grants one chosen gestalt member an extra round each combat turn; allows brief player coordination.
stars-without-number.power.unity-of-thou.blocked_reason: It links multiple minds and shares their thoughts and sensory impressions.

stars-without-number.power.personal-appo.name: Personal Apportation

effect.summary: Teleports the psychic to a previously occupied or visible location, carrying only what their natural strength can bear.

stars-without-number.power.personal-appo.cost_or_limit: Main Action; commit Effort for the scene. Range rises by skill level from 10 meters at level 0 to anywhere on a planet’s surface or near orbit at level 4.
stars-without-number.power.personal-appo.go_wrong: The psychic instinctively aborts a jump into solid matter or imminent physical harm; committed Effort and the action are lost.
stars-without-number.power.personal-appo.combines: Augmented by the other Teleportation techniques.
stars-without-number.power.personal-appo.mechanism: Spatial relocation to known or visible destinations.
stars-without-number.power.personal-appo.blocked_reason: The basic movement effect covers the stated relocation.

stars-without-number.power.proficient-ap.name: Proficient Apportation

effect.summary: Makes Personal Apportation faster and removes its Effort cost for jumps of 10 meters or less.

stars-without-number.power.proficient-ap.cost_or_limit: Personal Apportation becomes a Move action, usable once per round; augment costs still apply.
stars-without-number.power.proficient-ap.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 1 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.proficient-ap.mechanism: Alters an ability’s action and resource costs.
stars-without-number.power.proficient-ap.blocked_reason: The stated change can be represented as an alteration to the power’s operation.

stars-without-number.power.spatial-aware.name: Spatial Awareness

effect.summary: Provides intuitive 360-degree awareness of nearby surroundings, roughly like sight to 100 meters.

stars-without-number.power.spatial-aware.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort as an On Turn action; awareness lasts while Effort remains committed.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-aware.go_wrong: Solid objects block the sense; it cannot read text or distinguish colors.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-aware.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 1 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-aware.blocked_reason: The effect is sensory awareness over an area.

stars-without-number.power.burdened-appo.name: Burdened Apportation

effect.summary: Carries willing companions and limited inert cargo along with Personal Apportation.

stars-without-number.power.burdened-appo.cost_or_limit: Companions must be within 3 meters; up to three human-sized companions and their gear per Teleportation skill level. Up to 200 kilos of inert objects per skill level; commit one extra Effort for the day.
stars-without-number.power.burdened-appo.go_wrong: Resisting targets cannot be carried by this technique.
stars-without-number.power.burdened-appo.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 2 or higher; companions must be willing.
stars-without-number.power.burdened-appo.mechanism: Moves additional targets and carried matter during teleportation.
stars-without-number.power.burdened-appo.blocked_reason: The stated effect is movement of additional targets and cargo.

stars-without-number.power.perceptive-di.name: Perceptive Dislocation

effect.summary: Perceives a location the psychic could teleport to as though present there.

stars-without-number.power.perceptive-di.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort for the day; perception lasts at most fifteen minutes.
stars-without-number.power.perceptive-di.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 2 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.perceptive-di.mechanism: Remote perception of a possible destination.

stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.name: Spatial Synchrony Mandala

effect.summary: Tracks an imprinted object or willing person and permits teleporting near it within Personal Apportation range.

stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.cost_or_limit: One imprint at a time; object must weigh at least one kilogram and be relatively intact. Imprinting takes an hour’s meditation; a person must cooperate.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.go_wrong: Tracking requires the object to remain relatively intact and in range.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 2 or higher; a person being imprinted must consent.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.combines: Enables Personal Apportation to a point within three meters of the imprint.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.mechanism: Marking and tracking a target, with linked spatial relocation.
stars-without-number.power.spatial-synch.blocked_reason: Tracking and relocation to a marked target fit the available effects.

stars-without-number.power.effortless-ap.name: Effortless Apportation

effect.summary: Removes the Effort requirement for Personal Apportation.

stars-without-number.power.effortless-ap.cost_or_limit: Extra costs from augmenting techniques still apply.
stars-without-number.power.effortless-ap.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 3 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.effortless-ap.mechanism: Removes a resource cost from a power.
stars-without-number.power.effortless-ap.blocked_reason: The stated change is a power-cost alteration.

stars-without-number.power.stutterjump.name: Stutterjump

effect.summary: Micro-teleportation makes the psychic hard to hit, and a once-daily reflexive jump can negate a weapon hit or escape an area attack.

stars-without-number.power.stutterjump.cost_or_limit: Commit Effort to activate; negating a hit costs Effort for the day and works once per day.
stars-without-number.power.stutterjump.go_wrong: The micro-jumps do not significantly change the psychic’s location.
stars-without-number.power.stutterjump.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 3 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.stutterjump.combines: Its defensive jump can be used against weapon and area attacks.
stars-without-number.power.stutterjump.blocked_reason: Negating area-effect attacks requires an area-effect interaction beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.rift-reduplic.name: Rift Reduplication

effect.summary: Allows an extra Personal Apportation during a round, including a rapid departure after acting.

stars-without-number.power.rift-reduplic.cost_or_limit: Commit an additional Effort for the day; usable once per round, with normal apportation costs still applying.
stars-without-number.power.rift-reduplic.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 3 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.rift-reduplic.combines: Allows additional use of Personal Apportation.
stars-without-number.power.rift-reduplic.mechanism: Alters the timing and frequency of a power.
stars-without-number.power.rift-reduplic.blocked_reason: The stated effect is an additional use of movement.

stars-without-number.power.deep-intrusio.name: Deep Intrusion

effect.summary: Blind-teleports the psychic into a visible building, vehicle, structure, or nearby combat-engaged spacecraft, seeking a safe space.

stars-without-number.power.deep-intrusio.cost_or_limit: Commit one additional Effort point for the day; destination is not precisely controlled.
stars-without-number.power.deep-intrusio.go_wrong: The psychic cannot choose the exact destination, though they seek space without immediate hazards.
stars-without-number.power.deep-intrusio.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 4 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.deep-intrusio.mechanism: Spatial relocation into a visible enclosed structure.
stars-without-number.power.deep-intrusio.blocked_reason: The effect is movement to a constrained destination.

stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.name: Offensive Apportation

effect.summary: Teleports an unwilling target the psychic touches to an eligible destination; the psychic may accompany them if using Burdened Apportation.

stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.cost_or_limit: Costs one additional Effort point for the day, even if the required touch misses. Touching a resisting enemy requires a Punch hit roll; the target may make a Mental save to abort.
stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.go_wrong: A conscious resisting target may forcibly abort the teleportation.
stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.who_may: A psychic with Teleportation skill 4 or higher.
stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.combines: Uses Personal Apportation; Burdened Apportation permits the psychic to travel too.
stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.mechanism: Forced spatial relocation of a target.
stars-without-number.power.offensive-app.blocked_reason: The stated effect is movement of a touched target.

stars-without-number.power.adrenal-suppr.name: Adrenal Suppression Pump

effect.summary: When engaged, grants +2 initiative and dispassionate situational awareness.

stars-without-number.power.adrenal-suppr.cost_or_limit: Can run at most one hour per day; takes five rounds to toggle; applies -2 to social skill checks while active.
stars-without-number.power.adrenal-suppr.go_wrong: Safety overrides are intended to prevent addiction and brain damage.
stars-without-number.power.adrenal-suppr.mind: Suppresses brain chemicals and produces cold situational awareness; safeguards limit harm.
stars-without-number.power.adrenal-suppr.where_from: Cyberware; custom manufacture and implantation are scarce and costly on most worlds.
stars-without-number.power.adrenal-suppr.combines: Engagement uses System Strain under the cyberware rules.

stars-without-number.power.bioadaptation.name: Bioadaptation Augments

effect.summary: Allows survival in thin air and extreme heat or cold, and toleration of a wide range of native foods.

stars-without-number.power.bioadaptation.cost_or_limit: Permanent System Strain from cyberware applies.
stars-without-number.power.bioadaptation.combines: May combine with other cyberware, subject to System Strain.
stars-without-number.power.bioadaptation.blocked_reason: It changes the user's biological tolerance and physiology beyond ordinary effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.body-arsenal-.name: Body Arsenal Array
