effect.summary: Conceals built-in weapons, including advanced medium weapons and an energy projector comparable to a laser rifle.

stars-without-number.power.body-arsenal-.cost_or_limit: The projector requires an insertable type A cell; concealed arrays are detectable by medical examination.
stars-without-number.power.body-arsenal-.who_may: Implanted user; weapons use Punch or Stab skills.
stars-without-number.power.body-arsenal-.combines: Integral energy projector needs a type A cell.
stars-without-number.power.body-arsenal-.blocked_reason: The augmentation carries built-in weapons and a power-cell-dependent projector.

stars-without-number.power.body-sculptin.name: Body Sculpting

effect.summary: After a week of alterations, sets a person's outward appearance within human or near-human ranges.

stars-without-number.power.body-sculptin.cost_or_limit: Requires a week of treatment; permanent System Strain from cyberware applies.
stars-without-number.power.body-sculptin.where_from: Surgical services available on some TL4 worlds.
stars-without-number.power.body-sculptin.blocked_reason: It permanently transforms the subject's body and appearance.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic.name: telekinetic

effect.summary: A telekinetic character may forcibly eject a dangerous capacitor bank.

stars-without-number.power.telekinetic.combines: Can be used to address a ship crisis.
stars-without-number.power.telekinetic.blocked_reason: The passage gives no general range, target limits, or operating rules for telekinesis.

stars-without-number.power.spike-drive.name: spike drive

effect.summary: Carries a ship through metadimensions between stars.

stars-without-number.power.spike-drive.cost_or_limit: Needs a star to launch from and a star to return to; range is limited.
stars-without-number.power.spike-drive.go_wrong: Its protective bubble can fail amid hostile currents, destroying the ship.
stars-without-number.power.spike-drive.mind: A navigator must make course corrections on an unmapped route.
stars-without-number.power.spike-drive.who_may: Ships equipped with the drive and a navigating crew.
stars-without-number.power.spike-drive.combines: Uses stellar shadows as beacons and anchor points; course rutters can guide later trips.

stars-without-number.power.behavioral-im.name: behavioral imperatives

effect.summary: Imposes a powerful urge to perform a programmed kind of work.

stars-without-number.power.behavioral-im.cost_or_limit: The effect is overwhelming but not nuanced.
stars-without-number.power.behavioral-im.go_wrong: Complex limits are prone to failure or misguidance.
stars-without-number.power.behavioral-im.mind: Creates a deep urge to perform the specified work.
stars-without-number.power.behavioral-im.who_may: VIs can be programmed with them.
stars-without-number.power.behavioral-im.blocked_reason: An overwhelming behavioral compulsion requires mind-binding beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.curbs.name: curbs

effect.summary: Makes certain acts unbreakably difficult or impossible for the VI.

stars-without-number.power.curbs.cost_or_limit: Complex and specific limits are less reliable.
stars-without-number.power.curbs.go_wrong: May fail or misguide; clever VIs may sometimes out-think them.
stars-without-number.power.curbs.mind: Restricts the VI’s ability to choose or perform certain acts.
stars-without-number.power.curbs.who_may: VIs can be programmed with them.
stars-without-number.power.curbs.blocked_reason: An enduring restriction on a mind’s choices requires mind-binding.

stars-without-number.power.harmful-disch.name: Harmful discharges

effect.summary: Some beasts attack with corrosive, toxic, thermal, sonic, energy, chemical, or explosive discharges.

stars-without-number.power.harmful-disch.cost_or_limit: Usually requires a normal attack roll; damage is typical for the beast.
stars-without-number.power.harmful-disch.go_wrong: May poison victims, damage gear, continue corroding, or affect an area.
stars-without-number.power.harmful-disch.combines: May require Physical or Evasion saves to avoid added dangers.
stars-without-number.power.harmful-disch.blocked_reason: Some described discharge variants can affect an area, which the basic target grammar cannot fully specify.

stars-without-number.power.android.name: Android

effect.summary: Provides a human-indistinguishable android body and a skill related to its intended function.

stars-without-number.power.android.cost_or_limit: A medical-grade inspection can reveal the robot; zero HP exposes its mechanical interior.
stars-without-number.power.android.mind: Has the usual VI traits and abilities.
stars-without-number.power.android.who_may: A VI player character at creation, if allowed.
stars-without-number.power.android.combines: Granting the android form also grants its usual VI traits.
stars-without-number.power.android.blocked_reason: Changing a character into a distinct body form is not fully represented by the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.vi-worker-bot.name: VI Worker Bot

effect.summary: Grants a work-related skill and a +1 modifier to an associated attribute, capped at +2.

stars-without-number.power.vi-worker-bot.cost_or_limit: Must choose an attribute connected to the work.
stars-without-number.power.vi-worker-bot.mind: Has the usual VI traits and abilities.
stars-without-number.power.vi-worker-bot.who_may: A VI player character at creation, if allowed.
stars-without-number.power.vi-worker-bot.combines: Humanoid forms conveniently handle human-scale devices.

stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.name: VI Vehicle Bot

effect.summary: Turns the VI into a chosen vehicle, grants Pilot, and provides the vehicle’s armor.

stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.cost_or_limit: Vehicle choice requires GM approval; armor can be improved up to three times Fix skill at 1,000 credits per point.
stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.go_wrong: Control transmissions can be jammed by ECM, preventing surrogate-body piloting.
stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.mind: The VI may control its vehicle as its own limbs.
stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.who_may: A VI player character at creation, if allowed.
stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.combines: May pilot one surrogate body instead of its own Main Action when no ECM jams control.
stars-without-number.power.vi-vehicle-bo.blocked_reason: Becoming a vehicle and operating surrogate bodies require body transformation and remote-control mechanics beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.power.aptitude-for-.name: Aptitude for Violence

effect.summary: Improves the alien’s normal attack bonus by one.

stars-without-number.power.aptitude-for-.cost_or_limit: Applies to all members of the species.
stars-without-number.power.aptitude-for-.combines: Can be paired with an Origin Skill.
stars-without-number.power.aptitude-for-.blocked_reason: A persistent numerical attack bonus is supported by the basic game rules.

stars-without-number.power.environmental.name: Environmental Native

effect.summary: Allows survival in one relatively common hostile environment.

stars-without-number.power.environmental.cost_or_limit: If the species requires that environment, this provides no net benefit.
stars-without-number.power.environmental.blocked_reason: Survival in a hostile environment can be represented as a basic resistance.

stars-without-number.power.innate-abilit.name: Innate Ability

effect.summary: Grants one or more natural talents, such as dark vision or scent tracking.

stars-without-number.power.innate-abilit.cost_or_limit: May be modeled on two or three equipment or cyberware items, or a psionic technique with one Effort point.
stars-without-number.power.innate-abilit.combines: May emulate equipment, cyberware, or a psionic technique.
stars-without-number.power.innate-abilit.blocked_reason: The benefit can represent many unrelated effects, and no specific one is selected.

stars-without-number.power.natural-defen.name: Natural Defenses

effect.summary: Provides a base Armor Class of 15 plus half the character’s level, rounded up.

stars-without-number.power.natural-defen.cost_or_limit: May include claws or fangs equivalent to a medium advanced weapon.
stars-without-number.power.natural-defen.combines: Body weaponry may accompany the defense.
stars-without-number.power.natural-defen.mechanism: Armor Class and natural weapon rules.
stars-without-number.power.natural-defen.blocked_reason: The defensive and weapon benefits can be represented with ordinary combat rules.

stars-without-number.power.origin-skill.name: Origin Skill

effect.summary: Grants an appropriate skill as a bonus.

stars-without-number.power.origin-skill.cost_or_limit: Warrior-like species may choose Punch, Shoot, or Stab.
stars-without-number.power.origin-skill.blocked_reason: A skill bonus is supported by the basic rules.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-aptit.name: Psychic Aptitude

effect.summary: Requires psychic character options and raises maximum Effort by one.

stars-without-number.power.psychic-aptit.cost_or_limit: The character must be a Psychic or take the Partial Psychic Adventurer option.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-aptit.who_may: Psychically gifted aliens meeting the class requirement.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-aptit.combines: Pairs with psychic techniques and Effort.
stars-without-number.power.psychic-aptit.blocked_reason: The stated benefit uses ordinary character and Effort rules.

stars-without-number.power.shapeshifting.name: Shapeshifting

effect.summary: Either permits amoeboid movement and object manipulation or lets the alien imitate other forms.

stars-without-number.power.shapeshifting.cost_or_limit: Imitation may be limited in the forms available.
stars-without-number.power.shapeshifting.blocked_reason: Changing into or mimicking other forms exceeds the basic effect grammar’s supported body transformation.

stars-without-number.power.strong-attrib.name: Strong Attribute

effect.summary: Raises a chosen attribute modifier by one, to a maximum of plus three.

stars-without-number.power.strong-attrib.cost_or_limit: The attribute is chosen to suit the species.
stars-without-number.power.strong-attrib.blocked_reason: A persistent attribute modifier is supported by ordinary character rules.

stars-without-number.power.tough.name: Tough

effect.summary: The first hit die always counts as its maximum, and later dice that roll one are rerolled.

effect.summary: Projectile weapons gain +2 to hit and damage.

effect.summary: A faction described as having secret laboratories on a volcanic planetoid.

stars-without-number.institution.sororit.combines: Its laboratories may be destroyed during a PC adventure.
stars-without-number.institution.sororit.blocked_reason: No special entity effect is described.

stars-without-number.institution.exchang.name: Exchange Consulate

effect.summary: A pacifistic society of bankers and diplomats.

stars-without-number.institution.exchang.combines: Factions with ties to it gain its tag benefits.

stars-without-number.institution.precept.name: Preceptor Archive

effect.summary: A peaceful learning institution that spreads practical knowledge and engineering.

stars-without-number.institution.precept.combines: Its faction tag improves access to advanced assets.

stars-without-number.institution.planeta.name: Planetary Government

effect.summary: A planet's legitimate government holds control of state institutions.

stars-without-number.institution.planeta.cost_or_limit: Permission is required to buy or import designated assets; the tag may be taken once per planet controlled.
stars-without-number.institution.planeta.combines: Other factions may still have assets on the planet.

effect.summary: A group of mad gengineers mentioned as a possible target for an adventuring scheme.
A powerful religious organization with congregations on several worlds.
A star-spanning merchant consortium whose loyalty is to its wealth.

stars-without-number.institution.eugenic.name: Eugenics Cult

effect.summary: Its experimental medical treatments engineer human genetic traits.

stars-without-number.institution.eugenic.go_wrong: Treatments can make recipients unwilling converts.
stars-without-number.institution.eugenic.who_may: people who can access its treatments
stars-without-number.institution.eugenic.combines: The cult uses claims of superior breeding to legitimize rule.
stars-without-number.institution.eugenic.blocked_reason: Genetic engineering changes bodily form and traits beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.institution.rebel-f.name: Rebel Freedom Fighters

effect.summary: Rebel groups that arise against oppressive governments.

stars-without-number.institution.rebel-f.go_wrong: Crushed groups may be replaced by new ones.

effect.summary: A multistellar merchant corporation based on Danube.

stars-without-number.institution.way-of-.name: Way of Voth

effect.summary: A pretech-worshipping cult with a hidden base on Singularity.

stars-without-number.institution.way-of-.combines: Uses limited pretech artifacts to manipulate less-developed societies.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.name: Psychic Effort limit

effect.summary: A Psychic’s maximum Effort equals one plus their highest psychic skill and the better Wisdom or Constitution modifier, but never falls below one.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward resource limit.

stars-without-number.rule.partial-psychi.name: Partial Psychic skill restriction

effect.summary: A Partial Psychic can learn or improve only the single discipline they chose.

stars-without-number.rule.partial-psychi.cost_or_limit: Other psychic skills cannot be learned or improved.
stars-without-number.rule.partial-psychi.combines: The chosen skill can advance through foci or level-up points.
stars-without-number.rule.partial-psychi.blocked_reason: This is a defined restriction on skill access.

stars-without-number.rule.origin-focus-c.name: Origin focus character option

effect.summary: Aliens and robotic VIs can be represented by origin foci; an optional extra origin focus replaces the usual level-2 bonus focus.

stars-without-number.rule.origin-focus-c.cost_or_limit: The extra origin focus is at the GM’s discretion and uses the usual level-2 bonus focus.
stars-without-number.rule.origin-focus-c.who_may: Characters using an alien or robotic origin focus
stars-without-number.rule.origin-focus-c.combines: Origin foci are selected like other foci.
stars-without-number.rule.origin-focus-c.blocked_reason: This is a character-building rule, not an effect.

stars-without-number.rule.focus-stacking.name: Focus stacking

effect.summary: A higher focus level includes the benefits of lower levels, while most foci can be selected only once.

stars-without-number.rule.focus-stacking.cost_or_limit: Some skill-oriented foci may be taken more than once for different skills.
stars-without-number.rule.focus-stacking.combines: Higher levels build on lower levels.
stars-without-number.rule.focus-stacking.blocked_reason: This is a character advancement rule.

stars-without-number.rule.henchman-loyal.name: Henchman loyalty and danger

effect.summary: Henchmen serve loyally until betrayed or placed in unacceptable danger, while ordinary hired help is no more loyal than its pay and treatment warrant.

stars-without-number.rule.henchman-loyal.cost_or_limit: Henchmen may be released without resentment at a plausible time.
stars-without-number.rule.henchman-loyal.go_wrong: Betrayal or unacceptable danger ends their loyal service.
stars-without-number.rule.henchman-loyal.mind: Loyalty and willingness to risk danger are affected.
stars-without-number.rule.henchman-loyal.combines: Henchmen may be obtained through the focus or conventional inducements.
stars-without-number.rule.henchman-loyal.blocked_reason: The rule describes sustained loyalty and obedience from NPCs.

stars-without-number.rule.mes-danger-wit.name: MES danger without training

effect.summary: Unmediated MES power use commonly causes brain damage; repeated use can lead to death or madness.

stars-without-number.rule.mes-danger-wit.cost_or_limit: Safe controlled use requires appropriate training or damping.
stars-without-number.rule.mes-danger-wit.go_wrong: Brain damage, crippling disability, death, or madness.
stars-without-number.rule.mes-danger-wit.mind: May cause madness and severe impairment.
stars-without-number.rule.mes-danger-wit.combines: Untrained power use is especially hazardous.
stars-without-number.rule.mes-danger-wit.blocked_reason: The passage describes accumulating neural harm and madness rather than a basic effect alone.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-traini.name: Psychic training duration

effect.summary: Training generally takes one to four years, depending on aptitude and available support.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-traini.cost_or_limit: One to four years; tutors can shorten the process.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-traini.combines: Metapsionic deans damp and buffer novice minds during practice.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-traini.blocked_reason: A duration limit can be tracked directly.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.name: Psychic skill instruction

effect.summary: Only psychics can learn psionic skills, and attempting it without formal training is almost always lethal.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.cost_or_limit: A few prodigies can grasp the principles intuitively.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.go_wrong: Death or madness is likely without precautions.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.mind: Can result in madness or permanent brain damage.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.who_may: Psychics; rare natural prodigies are exceptions to the usual training route.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.where_from: The setting’s MES and psychic discipline rules.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.combines: Psychic class characters are unrestricted; Partial Psychic characters are restricted to one discipline.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-skill-.blocked_reason: The rule includes potentially lethal and lasting consequences for unsupervised development.

stars-without-number.rule.core-technique.name: Core technique acquisition

effect.summary: Reaching level 0 in a discipline grants its core technique, which improves as skill rises.

stars-without-number.rule.core-technique.cost_or_limit: The core technique does not require a separate purchase or training pick.
stars-without-number.rule.core-technique.combines: Further skill increases can grant additional technique picks.
stars-without-number.rule.core-technique.blocked_reason: The advancement condition can be represented directly.

stars-without-number.rule.technique-sele.name: Technique selection and retraining

effect.summary: Skill increases grant an immediate technique choice; extra techniques cost skill points and retraining is GM-controlled.

stars-without-number.rule.technique-sele.cost_or_limit: Technique requirements cannot exceed the psychic’s skill; extra techniques cost one skill point per technique level; retraining cannot exceed the old requirement.
stars-without-number.rule.technique-sele.combines: Some esoteric techniques require a trainer; academies may restrict standard techniques.
stars-without-number.rule.technique-sele.blocked_reason: The selection, cost, and prerequisite limits are explicit.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.name: Psychic Effort

effect.summary: A psychic commits Effort to powers, with the commitment lasting for the specified duration.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.cost_or_limit: Usually one Effort per activation; additional effects or triggers may need separate points. Effort refreshes after a good night’s rest.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.mind: Effort represents focus and neural responsiveness.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.combines: Commitment may last while active, for a scene, or for a day.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-effort.blocked_reason: A limited resource and its recovery can be tracked directly.

stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.name: System Strain limit and recovery

effect.summary: A target cannot benefit from an effect that would raise System Strain above Constitution; strain falls by one after a restful night when well-fed and healthy.

stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.go_wrong: An effect that exceeds the limit fails.
stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.who_may: Organisms affected by healing, implants, or drugs.
stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.combines: Psychic healing, cybernetics, and powerful drugs can add strain.
stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.blocked_reason: The cap and recovery rate can be tracked directly.

stars-without-number.rule.biopsionic-tou.name: Biopsionic touch requirement

effect.summary: Biopsionic effects usually require touch; touching willing or unsuspecting targets is automatic, while a resisting target requires a Punch hit roll with a Biopsionics bonus.

stars-without-number.rule.biopsionic-tou.cost_or_limit: Clothing and armor do not interfere; touch attacks do not inflict ordinary Punch damage.
stars-without-number.rule.biopsionic-tou.combines: Remote Repair can extend applicable effects to sighted targets at range.
stars-without-number.rule.biopsionic-tou.blocked_reason: The targeting and hit-roll conditions are explicit.

stars-without-number.rule.the-future-is-.name: The future is provisional

effect.summary: Future outcomes can change through deliberate action or random chance; clearer predictions can be easier to derail.

stars-without-number.rule.the-future-is-.where_from: The setting’s account of probability and precognition.

stars-without-number.rule.postcognition-.name: Postcognition is generally considered impossible

effect.summary: Psionic observation of the past is generally not possible.

stars-without-number.rule.postcognition-.cost_or_limit: Applies to psionic observation of past events.
stars-without-number.rule.postcognition-.where_from: The setting’s account of psychic perception.

stars-without-number.rule.telekinesis-do.name: Telekinesis does not normally affect held objects or unwilling intelligent targets

effect.summary: Telekinetic force normally cannot manipulate objects held or worn by mobile creatures or directly move unwilling intelligent targets.

stars-without-number.rule.telekinesis-do.combines: Non-sentient machines remain affectable as inanimate objects.

stars-without-number.rule.telekinesis-ca.name: Telekinesis cannot normally lift its user

effect.summary: A telekinetic cannot use the discipline to lift themselves without a special technique.

stars-without-number.rule.telekinesis-ca.cost_or_limit: Specific techniques can grant personal movement.

stars-without-number.rule.teleport-desti.name: Teleport destinations are fixed to major gravity wells

effect.summary: A destination remains tied to its nearest major gravity well, not to a moving vehicle or the planet’s former stellar position.

stars-without-number.rule.teleport-desti.blocked_reason: This is a destination constraint on spatial movement.

stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.name: Teleportation carries only whole matter

effect.summary: A teleporter may leave clothing or external matter behind, but cannot leave inserted matter behind or split an object between destinations.

stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.cost_or_limit: Resisting targets cannot be carried; willing targets must be touched.
stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.combines: Burdened Apportation permits specified additional passengers and cargo.
stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.mechanism: Matter selection and indivisible transfer constraint.
stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.blocked_reason: This constrains what matter accompanies a movement effect.

stars-without-number.rule.unsafe-apporta.name: Unsafe apportations abort

effect.summary: A psychic instinctively aborts a teleport that would embed them in solid matter or expose them to imminent physical harm.

stars-without-number.rule.unsafe-apporta.cost_or_limit: Any committed Effort and action spent on an aborted jump are wasted.
stars-without-number.rule.unsafe-apporta.go_wrong: The jump aborts and consumes its committed resources.
stars-without-number.rule.unsafe-apporta.blocked_reason: The rule constrains when a movement effect can complete.

stars-without-number.rule.fatal-injury-a.name: Fatal injury and death

effect.summary: Mortally wounded creatures die within six rounds without aid; additional damage kills them immediately.

stars-without-number.rule.fatal-injury-a.cost_or_limit: A mortally wounded target cannot perform useful actions; stabilization must occur before death.
stars-without-number.rule.fatal-injury-a.go_wrong: Failure to provide timely aid results in death.
stars-without-number.rule.fatal-injury-a.who_may: Applies to creatures brought to zero hit points by lethal injury.
stars-without-number.rule.fatal-injury-a.combines: Stabilization can prevent death if time remains; radiation-caused death cannot be reversed by stabilization techniques.
stars-without-number.rule.fatal-injury-a.blocked_reason: This rule is a basic vitality change and a timed endpoint.

stars-without-number.rule.stabilized-inj.name: Stabilized injury recovery

effect.summary: A stabilized target regains one hit point after ten minutes, but any further damage kills them until advanced healing removes the fragility.

stars-without-number.rule.stabilized-inj.cost_or_limit: Without advanced healing, recovery requires extended rest; recovery time depends on available medical technology.
stars-without-number.rule.stabilized-inj.go_wrong: Further damage before the fragility ends causes immediate death.
stars-without-number.rule.stabilized-inj.combines: Advanced pharmaceutical stims or Biopsionic techniques can remove the fragility.
stars-without-number.rule.stabilized-inj.blocked_reason: The rule uses vitality changes and a timed injury state.

stars-without-number.rule.poison-treatme.name: Poison treatment and revival

effect.summary: Successful treatment can negate poison; an antidote applied within six rounds can revive someone killed by poison with one hit point.

stars-without-number.rule.poison-treatme.cost_or_limit: Only one attempt can be made to neutralize a poison; an available specific antivenin always succeeds.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-treatme.go_wrong: A victim who is not treated in time may die; only one neutralization attempt is permitted.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-treatme.who_may: A medic or someone with an appropriate antidote or technique.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-treatme.combines: Biopsionic techniques, Heal checks, and specific antivenins can treat poison.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-treatme.blocked_reason: The described outcome is a vitality change.

stars-without-number.rule.radiation-pois.name: Radiation poisoning

effect.summary: Failed saves reduce Constitution; sufficiently severe exposure causes delayed or immediate death.

stars-without-number.rule.radiation-pois.cost_or_limit: Fatal radiation damage requires TL4 hospital or ship sick-bay treatment; non-fatal damage can be treated with a TL4 medkit and Heal check.
stars-without-number.rule.radiation-pois.go_wrong: Below half original Constitution, death follows in 1d6 weeks; below 3 Constitution, death is immediate; radiation-caused death cannot be reversed by stabilization techniques.
stars-without-number.rule.radiation-pois.where_from: Radiation sources, including lethal radiation zones.
stars-without-number.rule.radiation-pois.combines: Vacc suits and other protection can shield against weaker sources; treatment can restore lost Constitution.
stars-without-number.rule.radiation-pois.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as an area hazard with vitality changes and delayed effects.

stars-without-number.rule.hard-vacuum-ex.name: Hard vacuum exposure

effect.summary: After an initial period, exposure causes damage each round and may cause unconsciousness.

stars-without-number.rule.hard-vacuum-ex.cost_or_limit: The initial safe interval equals one plus the victim’s Constitution modifier in rounds.
stars-without-number.rule.hard-vacuum-ex.go_wrong: Continued exposure causes repeated damage and loss of consciousness.
stars-without-number.rule.hard-vacuum-ex.blocked_reason: The rule can be run as sustained, repeated vitality loss.

stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.name: Hacking access and control

effect.summary: A successful hack can retrieve data or control an automated system; ordinary control lasts 1d4 rounds plus Program skill before detection and lockout.

stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.cost_or_limit: A connection is generally required; a prepared hack takes a Main Action, an improvised hack ten minutes, and a rushed hack incurs a difficulty penalty.
stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.go_wrong: A failed hack requires a second check to avoid an alarm and trace; failure alerts human overseers to the hacker’s location.
stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.who_may: A character able to connect and make an Int/Program check.
stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.combines: Line shunts can extend a hack until disturbed; repeated attempts raise difficulty.
stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.mechanism: computer access, control, and intrusion detection
stars-without-number.rule.hacking-access.blocked_reason: The effects are performed through a connected system, with access duration and security responses beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.rule.repeated-hacki.name: Repeated hacking attempts

effect.summary: Each hack after the first against the same system within 24 hours becomes more difficult.

stars-without-number.rule.repeated-hacki.cost_or_limit: The difficulty penalty increases by one per additional attempt in that period.
stars-without-number.rule.repeated-hacki.go_wrong: Repeated attempts make further access harder.
stars-without-number.rule.repeated-hacki.who_may: Anyone hacking the same system repeatedly.
stars-without-number.rule.repeated-hacki.combines: Applies whether earlier attempts succeeded or failed.
stars-without-number.rule.repeated-hacki.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward increasing difficulty limit.

stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.name: Line-shunt persistence

effect.summary: With enough line shunts in place, a hack lasts until the shunts are disturbed.

stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.cost_or_limit: The required number depends on system security, and shunts must be placed at particular locations.
stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.go_wrong: A shunt being found or disturbed ends the extended hack.
stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.who_may: A hacker who can place the required shunts.
stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.where_from: Data lines within a building or structure.
stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.combines: Line shunts must be used with the relevant hacking attempt.
stars-without-number.rule.line-shunt-per.blocked_reason: An item sustains another effect, and the required number of items varies with the target system.

stars-without-number.rule.foreign-data-p.name: Foreign data protocols

effect.summary: A hacker needs the target system’s protocols before making effective attempts against unfamiliar systems.

stars-without-number.rule.foreign-data-p.cost_or_limit: Protocols can be learned through manuals and practice, shared knowledge, or experimentation on local hardware.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-data-p.go_wrong: Without the protocols, the hacker cannot make an effective attempt.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-data-p.who_may: A hacker facing a foreign or unfamiliar system.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-data-p.combines: Program skill reduces the practice time needed with manuals.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-data-p.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward access restriction.

stars-without-number.rule.nihil-ultra-di.name: Nihil Ultra directive

effect.summary: Prohibits three broad categories of maltech.

stars-without-number.rule.nihil-ultra-di.cost_or_limit: Frontier worlds commonly forbid maltech research and possession.
stars-without-number.rule.nihil-ultra-di.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as a restriction on creating or possessing specified technologies.

stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.name: Thou shalt not make tools of humankind.

effect.summary: Forbids eugenic technology designed to enslave or control people.

stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.cost_or_limit: Broad, drawback-free human improvements are difficult to achieve.
stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.mind: The prohibited techniques can limit intelligence or will.
stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.blocked_reason: This is a research and possession restriction, not an effect requiring extra mechanics.

stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.name: Thou shalt not create unbraked minds.

effect.summary: Requires human-equivalent AIs to have intentional flaws or brakes.

stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.cost_or_limit: Human-level AIs must include artificial forgetfulness and irrationality.
stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.go_wrong: Without brakes an AI risks fixation, obsession, and eventual extreme insanity.
stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.mind: Brakes deliberately introduce forgetfulness and irrationality.
stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.blocked_reason: Modeling an AI's escalating fixation and insanity requires a mental-drift mechanic.

stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.name: Thou shalt not create devices of planetary destruction.

effect.summary: Forbids technology designed to make habitable planets unlivable.

stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.cost_or_limit: Such weapons threaten the supply of habitable worlds.
stars-without-number.rule.thou-shalt-not.blocked_reason: The rule is a restriction on developing or possessing a class of device.

stars-without-number.rule.technology-lev.name: Technology levels

effect.summary: Classifies a world's technological infrastructure from TL0 through TL6.

stars-without-number.rule.technology-lev.cost_or_limit: TL0 is Neolithic; TL5 reflects Mandate-era capability; TL6 effects are indistinguishable from magic.
stars-without-number.rule.technology-lev.blocked_reason: The scale is a straightforward setting classification.

stars-without-number.rule.one-type-a-pow.name: One Type A power cell recharges an energy weapon magazine.

effect.summary: A Type A cell is sufficient to recharge an energy weapon's magazine.

stars-without-number.rule.one-type-a-pow.combines: Weapon types use compatible power cells.
stars-without-number.rule.one-type-a-pow.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward recharge rule.

stars-without-number.rule.burst-mode.name: Burst Mode

effect.summary: Fires three rounds for +2 to hit and damage against the target.

stars-without-number.rule.burst-mode.cost_or_limit: Consumes three rounds; additional ammunition beyond this is impractical.
stars-without-number.rule.burst-mode.go_wrong: Energy weapons risk meltdown and projectile weapons may buck uncontrollably if overfed.
stars-without-number.rule.burst-mode.who_may: Users of weapons capable of burst fire.
stars-without-number.rule.burst-mode.combines: Projectile weapons spend bullets; energy weapons spread or intensify their beam.
stars-without-number.rule.burst-mode.blocked_reason: The attack bonus and ammunition cost fit basic combat effects.

stars-without-number.rule.shock.name: Shock

effect.summary: A melee miss can still inflict listed Shock damage on a target with sufficiently low AC.

stars-without-number.rule.shock.cost_or_limit: Includes relevant attribute and bonus damage; a hit cannot do less than Shock.
stars-without-number.rule.shock.mind: Represents cuts, bruises, exhaustion, and terror.
stars-without-number.rule.shock.combines: A shield blocks the first effective melee Shock instance per round.
stars-without-number.rule.shock.mechanism: Miss damage and minimum melee damage
stars-without-number.rule.shock.blocked_reason: Shock is a combat damage rule.

stars-without-number.rule.heavy-weapon-s.name: Heavy weapon suppression

effect.summary: Doubles ammunition use to automatically hit exposed targets in front for half damage.

stars-without-number.rule.heavy-weapon-s.cost_or_limit: A successful Evasion save negates the damage.
stars-without-number.rule.heavy-weapon-s.combines: Does not affect targets under hard cover.
stars-without-number.rule.heavy-weapon-s.blocked_reason: An area attack with cover and save conditions fits basic combat resolution.

stars-without-number.rule.ammunition-int.name: Ammunition interchangeability

effect.summary: Projectile ammunition can be treated as interchangeable among projectile weapons.

stars-without-number.rule.ammunition-int.cost_or_limit: Calibers are not tracked for simplicity.
stars-without-number.rule.ammunition-int.go_wrong: A few primitive or resource-poor worlds cannot manufacture ammunition.
stars-without-number.rule.ammunition-int.combines: Local gunsmiths can load custom specifications.

stars-without-number.rule.power-cell-com.name: Power cell compatibility

effect.summary: Mandate-pattern cells are broadly compatible with devices from different worlds.

stars-without-number.rule.power-cell-com.cost_or_limit: Type A and Type B cells cannot exchange or recharge each other without a trained technician's modification or a converter.
stars-without-number.rule.power-cell-com.who_may: A trained technician can modify them; otherwise use a converter.
stars-without-number.rule.power-cell-com.combines: Cells can recharge from a ship plant or other grid.
stars-without-number.rule.power-cell-com.blocked_reason: The compatibility and conversion restriction are basic item rules.

stars-without-number.rule.foreign-protoc.name: Foreign Protocols

effect.summary: Locally incompatible hardware cannot communicate until its protocols are reset.

stars-without-number.rule.foreign-protoc.cost_or_limit: Resetting a group's equipment usually takes at least a day and requires Program or Fix skills.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-protoc.who_may: A character with Program or Fix skills can attempt the reset.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-protoc.where_from: Worlds that deliberately abandon the Mandate-derived protocol.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-protoc.combines: Most surviving worlds retain basic protocol compatibility.
stars-without-number.rule.foreign-protoc.blocked_reason: The rule defines a communications restriction and its repair procedure.

stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.name: System Strain limits pharmaceutical effects

effect.summary: A stim has no positive effect when the subject's System Strain is already too high; some stims also add Strain.

stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.cost_or_limit: Depends on the specific stim and the subject's current Strain.
stars-without-number.rule.system-strain-.go_wrong: Excess Strain can prevent positive effects.

stars-without-number.rule.quantum-ecm-li.name: Quantum ECM limits drones

effect.summary: Quantum ECM makes remote control of unwired drones unreliable near battlefields or important civil structures.

stars-without-number.rule.quantum-ecm-li.cost_or_limit: Drones remain feasible in wild areas or away from urban centers; Alectos can function when cut off.
stars-without-number.rule.quantum-ecm-li.who_may: Applies to drone operators and systems.
stars-without-number.rule.quantum-ecm-li.combines: Expert Systems are also scrambled by quantum ECM.

stars-without-number.rule.drone-control-.name: Drone control and power

effect.summary: A control link handles one drone plus the user's Program skill; a handheld unit handles one, and each drone uses one type A cell per hour.

stars-without-number.rule.drone-control-.cost_or_limit: Pilot spends a Main Action each round to command movement or shooting; uncommanded link-controlled drones stay still, while handheld ones risk crashing.
stars-without-number.rule.drone-control-.go_wrong: Handheld control failures can crash a drone.
stars-without-number.rule.drone-control-.who_may: Drone pilot with control link or handheld unit.
stars-without-number.rule.drone-control-.combines: Drone combat uses pilot's Pilot or Program skill and base attack bonus.

stars-without-number.rule.drone-fittings.name: Drone fittings are permanent

effect.summary: A fitting cannot be removed without severe structural damage, and all fittings are lost if the drone is destroyed.

stars-without-number.rule.drone-fittings.cost_or_limit: Repairing damage costs one spare-parts unit per five lost HP and an hour of Fix-0 work.
stars-without-number.rule.drone-fittings.go_wrong: Removal damages the drone; destruction destroys every fitting.
stars-without-number.rule.drone-fittings.who_may: Applies to drone owners and repairers.
stars-without-number.rule.drone-fittings.blocked_reason: Fitting attachment and destruction-dependent loss require stateful item rules.

stars-without-number.rule.cyberware-impo.name: Cyberware imposes permanent System Strain

effect.summary: Each cyberware piece permanently adds System Strain, which can be removed only by surgical removal of that ware.

stars-without-number.rule.cyberware-impo.cost_or_limit: Permanent Strain reduces capacity for psionic healing and can limit healing and stimulant drugs; activation costs cannot exceed Constitution.
stars-without-number.rule.cyberware-impo.go_wrong: A user unable to pay activation Strain cannot activate the ware until recovered.
stars-without-number.rule.cyberware-impo.combines: Activation Strain adds to the wearer's existing total.
stars-without-number.rule.cyberware-impo.mechanism: Permanent body-resource cost and activation threshold
stars-without-number.rule.cyberware-impo.blocked_reason: Implants carry persistent effects and costs, while the grammar has no item-bound power or permanent resource-capacity mechanism.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-eligibilit.name: Mod eligibility and installation

effect.summary: Mods normally apply only to TL4 gear and require a suitable TL4 workshop and the required Fix skill.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-eligibilit.cost_or_limit: Minimum Fix skill depends on mod; without it a tech cannot build, install, or maintain the mod.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-parts-and-.name: Mod parts and salvage

effect.summary: Mods use purchased parts or specified pretech salvage, with any salvage units interchangeable.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-parts-and-.cost_or_limit: Some advanced mods require salvage obtainable from particular Mandate devices or caches.
stars-without-number.rule.mod-parts-and-.go_wrong: Ordinary money may not secure salvage held for others' purposes.
stars-without-number.rule.mod-parts-and-.combines: Salvage is tracked as generic units rather than specific components.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-installati.name: Mod installation time

effect.summary: Building and installing a mod takes one week per minimum skill level.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-installati.cost_or_limit: Working continuously halves the time; a Fix-0 assistant halves it again.
stars-without-number.rule.mod-installati.combines: Assistant and continuous-work reductions can apply.

stars-without-number.rule.mods-must-be-c.name: Mods must be custom-built

effect.summary: A mod must be designed for its particular device, sometimes for a particular user.

stars-without-number.rule.mods-must-be-c.cost_or_limit: Generic detachable mods cannot be made.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-maintenanc.name: Mod maintenance

effect.summary: A technician must maintain mods daily; neglected mods stop working after 24 hours, and their devices fail after a week.

stars-without-number.rule.mod-maintenanc.cost_or_limit: Maintenance capacity is Intelligence modifier plus Constitution modifier plus three times Fix skill; ordinary capacity is the number of mods maintained without consuming off-duty time.
stars-without-number.rule.mod-maintenanc.go_wrong: Neglect can make the whole device useless or dangerous.
stars-without-number.rule.mod-maintenanc.who_may: Technicians with adequate Fix skill and a TL4 toolbox.
stars-without-number.rule.mod-maintenanc.combines: All-day maintenance doubles capacity but requires sixteen-hour workdays; an hour of qualified work clears a backlog.

stars-without-number.rule.workshop-refit.name: Workshop refitting

effect.summary: A workshop can be refitted for unsupported gear by paying half its original price.

stars-without-number.rule.workshop-refit.cost_or_limit: Shop must otherwise be suitable for the type of equipment; a shipboard Workshop is sufficient for personal gear.

stars-without-number.rule.jury-rigged-de.name: Jury-rigged device rule

effect.summary: Jury-rigged devices cost one-quarter of normal price and half normal build time, but need Fix-0 maintenance and cannot be modded.

stars-without-number.rule.jury-rigged-de.cost_or_limit: Scrap or salvage can remove the cost but doubles build time.
stars-without-number.rule.jury-rigged-de.go_wrong: Stops working after 24 hours without maintenance.

stars-without-number.rule.normal-device-.name: Normal device rule

effect.summary: Normally built devices cost twice retail and take the standard build time.

stars-without-number.rule.normal-device-.cost_or_limit: Scrap or salvage is allowed only if the GM considers it perfectly suitable; consumables must be built as normal devices.

stars-without-number.rule.mastercrafted-.name: Mastercrafted device rule

effect.summary: Mastercrafted devices cost ten times normal and take twice as long, but are easier to modify and maintain.

stars-without-number.rule.mastercrafted-.cost_or_limit: First installed mod needs no maintenance.
stars-without-number.rule.mastercrafted-.combines: Designed as a platform for the maker's modifications.

effect.summary: Weapon and armor bonuses cap at +3, skill-check improvement caps at +1, and each mod can be installed only once per item.

stars-without-number.rule.starship-hull-.name: Starship hull classes and attributes

effect.summary: Ships use hull classes with defined attributes for speed, armor, hit points, crew, power, mass, hardpoints, and scale.

stars-without-number.rule.starship-hull-.cost_or_limit: Fittings and weapons consume power, mass, and hardpoints; some require a minimum hull class.
stars-without-number.rule.starship-hull-.combines: Hull class determines fitting capacity and some fitting costs.
stars-without-number.rule.starship-hull-.blocked_reason: This defines ship construction and capabilities.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-armor-and.name: Ship armor and damage

effect.summary: Ship armor reduces incoming damage; ordinary small arms and TL3 Heavy weapons cannot harm starship hulls.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-armor-and.cost_or_limit: Exterior TL4 Heavy weapons and demo charges deal half damage minus armor; internal attacks deal half damage without armor.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-armor-and.combines: Armor-piercing weapons can ignore some or all armor.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-armor-and.blocked_reason: This is a defined damage and resistance rule.

stars-without-number.rule.crew-and-life-.name: Crew and life support

effect.summary: A ship lists minimum crew and a maximum number supportable for two months.

stars-without-number.rule.crew-and-life-.cost_or_limit: Smaller crews extend supplies proportionally; safe drills normally require at least three crew; a lone operator needs heavy pharmaceuticals and desperation.
stars-without-number.rule.crew-and-life-.go_wrong: Insufficient crew makes safe drilling difficult.
stars-without-number.rule.crew-and-life-.mind: A lone crewman needs drugs to remain awake and vigilant.
stars-without-number.rule.crew-and-life-.combines: Extended life support and stores can change capacity or duration.
stars-without-number.rule.crew-and-life-.blocked_reason: This defines resource and crew limits.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-maintenan.name: Ship maintenance

effect.summary: A ship owes maintenance equal to 5% of non-crew cost every six months.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-maintenan.cost_or_limit: Skipping each maintenance period applies a cumulative -1 penalty to ship-related skill checks and hit rolls.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-maintenan.who_may: Ship owners or crew responsible for upkeep.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-maintenan.combines: A mobile factory can pay repair or maintenance costs with parts.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-maintenan.blocked_reason: It defines a recurring cost and its penalty.

stars-without-number.rule.shipyard-work-.name: Shipyard work rate

effect.summary: Typical shipyards complete 25,000 credits of work or modifications per day.

stars-without-number.rule.shipyard-work-.cost_or_limit: Urgent work may double or quadruple the rate.
stars-without-number.rule.shipyard-work-.combines: Work rate depends on shipyard quality and the job's political importance.
stars-without-number.rule.shipyard-work-.blocked_reason: This is a defined production-rate rule.

stars-without-number.rule.starship-acqui.name: Starship acquisition and civilian access

effect.summary: Civilian ships are generally purchasable on TL4 worlds, while military hulls require strong contacts or favors.

stars-without-number.rule.starship-acqui.cost_or_limit: Civilian access is usually limited to fighter or frigate hulls; conspicuous armed purchases may draw attention; military ships may be unaffordable to crew.
stars-without-number.rule.starship-acqui.go_wrong: Unusual purchases may attract unwelcome interest.
stars-without-number.rule.starship-acqui.who_may: Civilian buyers or those with government connections.
stars-without-number.rule.starship-acqui.combines: Letters of marque can permit purchase of normally restricted hulls.
stars-without-number.rule.starship-acqui.blocked_reason: It defines who may acquire restricted goods.

stars-without-number.rule.starship-price.name: Starship price adjustment by sector

effect.summary: In regions where ships are easier to obtain, listed prices may be halved or quartered.

stars-without-number.rule.starship-price.cost_or_limit: Applies to campaigns in sectors with easier ship access.

stars-without-number.rule.system-drive-r.name: System drive restriction

effect.summary: A system-drive ship can maneuver and travel within a system but cannot make interstellar drills.

stars-without-number.rule.system-drive-r.cost_or_limit: The spike drive is removed; hull cost falls by 10%, while free power and mass increase.
stars-without-number.rule.system-drive-r.who_may: Ships fitted with a system drive.
stars-without-number.rule.system-drive-r.combines: The ship is treated as drive-1 for maneuvering and system transit.
stars-without-number.rule.system-drive-r.blocked_reason: It defines a clear limitation on interstellar travel.

stars-without-number.rule.interstellar-d.name: Interstellar drill fuel

effect.summary: Most ships require refueling after each spike drill, regardless of jump distance.

stars-without-number.rule.interstellar-d.cost_or_limit: Fuel bunkers add one more drill between refuelings.
stars-without-number.rule.interstellar-d.combines: Fuel scoops can harvest fuel from stellar bodies.
stars-without-number.rule.interstellar-d.blocked_reason: This defines a consumable cost per journey.

stars-without-number.rule.colony-core-pe.name: Colony core permanence

effect.summary: Activating a colony core permanently converts a ship into a settlement.

stars-without-number.rule.colony-core-pe.cost_or_limit: The ship cannot be repacked; if landed, it can never take off again.
stars-without-number.rule.colony-core-pe.go_wrong: The ship is permanently lost as a starship.
stars-without-number.rule.colony-core-pe.blocked_reason: The rule requires permanent transformation of a vehicle into a settlement.

stars-without-number.rule.exodus-bay-awa.name: Exodus bay awakening

effect.summary: Exodus-bay occupants require a month to defrost from deep hibernation.

stars-without-number.rule.exodus-bay-awa.cost_or_limit: A crash awakening has a 25% chance of killing the subject; pods are rated for 100 years, with actual maximum duration uncertain.
stars-without-number.rule.exodus-bay-awa.go_wrong: Abrupt awakening may kill a subject.
stars-without-number.rule.exodus-bay-awa.blocked_reason: The passage specifies a life-state transition with mortality risk that the basic effect grammar cannot resolve.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-re.name: Spike drill regulator success conditions

effect.summary: A regulator guarantees known-route drills within twice the pilot's skill if no course trimming is needed.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-re.cost_or_limit: Requires a suitable technical base and metadimensional energy conditions.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-re.who_may: Ships with a compatible regulator and navigator.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-re.combines: A campaign may exclude the fitting to keep travel dangerous.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-re.blocked_reason: It changes the result of a check under defined conditions.

stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.name: Teleportation limits

effect.summary: Ship teleporters move at most twelve people or 1,200 kilograms and can operate once every five minutes.

stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.cost_or_limit: Range is a few tens of thousands of kilometers; planetary use requires no physical barrier; ship-to-ship use requires cooperation or a friendly signal.
stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.go_wrong: A blocked path or unavailable target signal prevents the teleport.
stars-without-number.rule.teleportation-.blocked_reason: This states limits and conditions for a teleportation effect.

stars-without-number.rule.ammo.name: Ammo

effect.summary: Weapons with this quality consume ammunition; storage capacity depends on rating and hull size.

stars-without-number.rule.ammo.cost_or_limit: One free mass unit of ammunition is included with installation; larger hulls store more per unit.
stars-without-number.rule.ammo.blocked_reason: The ammunition limit can be tracked directly.

stars-without-number.rule.ap.name: AP

effect.summary: Reduces the target ship’s effective armor by the weapon’s AP rating, at most to zero.

stars-without-number.rule.ap.cost_or_limit: Cannot reduce armor below zero or add damage.
stars-without-number.rule.ap.combines: Hardened Polyceramic Overlay can lessen its effectiveness.
stars-without-number.rule.ap.blocked_reason: Armor reduction is representable as a direct adjustment.

stars-without-number.rule.cloud.name: Cloud

effect.summary: Attacks all fighter-class ships that attacked the firing ship during the prior round.

stars-without-number.rule.cloud.cost_or_limit: Does not affect larger ships or people on the hull.
stars-without-number.rule.cloud.combines: One attack roll is made against each eligible target.
stars-without-number.rule.cloud.blocked_reason: The basic effect grammar does not specify selecting multiple targets in an area.

stars-without-number.rule.clumsy.name: Clumsy

effect.summary: Imposes a penalty when firing at fighter-class hulls.

stars-without-number.rule.clumsy.cost_or_limit: Minus four to hit small fighter-class hulls.
stars-without-number.rule.clumsy.blocked_reason: The penalty can be applied as a direct numerical modifier.

stars-without-number.rule.flak.name: Flak

effect.summary: Against fighter-class targets, roll hits and damage twice and use the better result.

stars-without-number.rule.flak.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct change to attack resolution.

stars-without-number.rule.ground-weapons.name: Ground weapons versus ships

effect.summary: Ground fire damages ships differently according to weapon type and technological level.

stars-without-number.rule.ground-weapons.cost_or_limit: TL3 small arms do no damage; persistent TL4 small-arms fire deals damage over time; heavy weapons inflict half rolled damage minus ship armor.
stars-without-number.rule.ground-weapons.combines: Ground defenses and ship armor determine the result.
stars-without-number.rule.ground-weapons.blocked_reason: The damage adjustments are numerical and directly implementable.

stars-without-number.rule.grounded-ship-.name: Grounded ship targeting

effect.summary: A grounded ship cannot be missed; a flying ship’s armor class depends on its flight situation.

stars-without-number.rule.grounded-ship-.cost_or_limit: Flight AC is given as 10, 15, or 20 for the described situations.
stars-without-number.rule.grounded-ship-.blocked_reason: The rule assigns direct target values.

stars-without-number.rule.active-ground-.name: Active ground anti-ship defenses

effect.summary: An exposed ship risks severe damage each round it fails to evade a ground defense.

stars-without-number.rule.active-ground-.cost_or_limit: Evasion uses a Pilot check of difficulty 8–10; a miss deals 2d10 damage with AP 20; escaping the firing angle takes surviving three rounds.
stars-without-number.rule.active-ground-.go_wrong: A failed evasion check triggers the attack.
stars-without-number.rule.active-ground-.mechanism: repeated skill check and triggered attack
stars-without-number.rule.active-ground-.blocked_reason: The repeated check and damage trigger are ordinary game procedures.

stars-without-number.rule.maintenance-sc.name: Maintenance score for ship modifications

effect.summary: An engineer’s capacity to maintain modifications depends on attributes and Fix skill.

stars-without-number.rule.maintenance-sc.cost_or_limit: The score equals Intelligence modifier plus Constitution modifier plus three times Fix; maintained mods cannot exceed the score.
stars-without-number.rule.maintenance-sc.combines: Equipment and starship modifications both count against the same score.
stars-without-number.rule.maintenance-sc.blocked_reason: The limit is a direct numerical capacity.

stars-without-number.rule.neglected-ship.name: Neglected ship modifications

effect.summary: An unmaintained ship mod fails after a week of active use.

stars-without-number.rule.neglected-ship.cost_or_limit: At least eight hours of skilled repair restores it; parked ships do not count as active.
stars-without-number.rule.neglected-ship.go_wrong: Dependent fittings and functions also stop working until repair.
stars-without-number.rule.neglected-ship.combines: Close teamwork can let multiple engineers maintain a mod.
stars-without-number.rule.neglected-ship.blocked_reason: The time limit and repair condition are directly trackable.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-mod-insta.name: Ship-mod installation

effect.summary: A crew can build a modification using labor, credits, and sometimes rare pretech components.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-mod-insta.cost_or_limit: Labor proceeds at a rate based on cost; lone engineers cannot modify ships larger than frigates.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-mod-insta.go_wrong: Tearing out a mod returns pretech components but wastes credit investment.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-mod-insta.blocked_reason: Costs, components, labor, and installation limits can be tracked directly.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.name: Ship redesign limits

effect.summary: Redesigning or rebuilding can make selected modifications part of the ship’s basic structure.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.cost_or_limit: Rebuilding costs five times the normal price and twice the components; redesigned ships allow at most twice the engineer’s Fix score in integrated mods.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.go_wrong: Further bolted-on mods still require maintenance.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.who_may: Engineer with shipyard support and resources.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.combines: New hulls can integrate modifications at the normal mod price.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.mechanism: construction, resource cost, and capacity limit
stars-without-number.rule.ship-redesign-.blocked_reason: The cost and modification limits are directly implementable.

stars-without-number.rule.gravitic-trans.name: Gravitic transition zones

effect.summary: A stellar gravity gradient is needed to enter or exit metadimensional space.

stars-without-number.rule.gravitic-trans.cost_or_limit: Only a star provides a strong enough gradient; interstellar rocks and debris do not.
stars-without-number.rule.gravitic-trans.go_wrong: Without a usable transition, a ship cannot enter or leave the continuum.
stars-without-number.rule.gravitic-trans.combines: The star’s gravity supplies the required transition.
stars-without-number.rule.gravitic-trans.blocked_reason: The travel restriction can be applied as a location requirement.

stars-without-number.rule.fixed-arrival-.name: Fixed arrival zones

effect.summary: An arriving ship emerges at the system edge corresponding to its approach direction.

stars-without-number.rule.fixed-arrival-.cost_or_limit: Ships cannot overshoot the arrival zone; departure can begin from any rim location toward any reachable destination.
stars-without-number.rule.fixed-arrival-.combines: Polities can fortify likely arrival paths.
stars-without-number.rule.fixed-arrival-.blocked_reason: The arrival location can be set by the ship’s approach direction.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-ra.name: Spike-drive range

effect.summary: A spike drive can reach destinations within a number of sector-map hexes equal to its rating.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-ra.cost_or_limit: Distance depends on the drive rating and the available metadimensional route.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-ra.go_wrong: A nearby star may still be unreachable through dangerous or disrupted space.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-ra.combines: A safe course may require a recent rutter.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-ra.blocked_reason: The range is a direct numerical constraint.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-fu.name: Spike-drill fuel

effect.summary: A successful spike drill consumes one load of fuel.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-fu.cost_or_limit: Most ships hold one load; bunkers allow more; refueling costs a fixed amount per load.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-fu.go_wrong: A ship without a fuel load cannot make the drill.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-fu.combines: Fuel scoops can collect fuel from stars or gas giants.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-fu.blocked_reason: Fuel expenditure and storage are directly trackable.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-ti.name: Spike-drill time

effect.summary: Transit takes six days per hex, divided by the drive rating.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-ti.cost_or_limit: Entering metadimensional space normally takes thirty minutes; rushing increases risk; trimming course increases effective speed without increasing range.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-ti.go_wrong: Risky procedures can increase the chance of a mishap.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-ti.combines: Drive rating and route distance determine travel time.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-ti.blocked_reason: Travel duration and modifiers can be calculated directly.

stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.name: Course record (rutter)

effect.summary: A rutter provides route data needed to guide a spike drill.

stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.cost_or_limit: Older records raise drill risk; drilling without a rutter is exceptionally dangerous.
stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.go_wrong: Stale or absent information can make a drill hazardous.
stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.where_from: Reports of metadimensional currents and energetic weather.
stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.combines: The record’s age modifies the drill difficulty.
stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.mechanism: route information prerequisite and difficulty modifier
stars-without-number.rule.course-record-.blocked_reason: The information requirement and its difficulty modifiers are directly trackable.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.name: Spike-drill pilot requirement

effect.summary: A sentient-grade intellect must pilot a spike drill; ordinary expert systems cannot do so.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.cost_or_limit: Most ships need three crew to cover watches, though only one must be a pilot; a lone pilot may use drugs to stay awake for up to a week.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.go_wrong: Lack of a capable pilot prevents a drill.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.mind: A lone pilot may use drugs to resist sleep.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.who_may: A human or other sentient-grade intellect.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.combines: Crew size and drugs can support extended solo piloting.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-pi.blocked_reason: Eligibility, staffing, and duration limits can be applied directly.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-mi.name: Spike-drill mishaps

effect.summary: A failed navigation check can disable systems, delay the ship, or send it off course.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-mi.cost_or_limit: The result depends on a mishap roll; severe results can destroy the drive and all systems.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-mi.go_wrong: Outcomes range from lost time to severe system destruction or displacement.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-mi.who_may: Ships making a failed spike-drill check.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-mi.combines: Mishap severity depends on the roll.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drill-mi.blocked_reason: A roll table can implement the listed failures and consequences.

stars-without-number.rule.intra-system-t.name: Intra-system travel

effect.summary: Travel within a solar system takes six hours within a region or forty-eight hours between regions, divided by drive rating.

stars-without-number.rule.intra-system-t.cost_or_limit: Normally carries no risk or Pilot checks; course trimming requires a difficulty-9 check and failure doubles travel time.
stars-without-number.rule.intra-system-t.go_wrong: A failed trimming check makes the journey take twice as long.
stars-without-number.rule.intra-system-t.combines: Regions group nearby places of interest.
stars-without-number.rule.intra-system-t.blocked_reason: Travel times and their modifiers are directly calculable.

stars-without-number.rule.detection-lock.name: Detection lock

effect.summary: An observer who wins an opposed check can track a locked ship anywhere in the system.

stars-without-number.rule.detection-lock.cost_or_limit: Observer must be in the same space region; a failed or tied attempt cannot be retried for 24 hours.
stars-without-number.rule.detection-lock.combines: Active sensors reveal the attempt; passive sensors conceal it but make locking harder.

stars-without-number.rule.breaking-a-det.name: Breaking a detection lock

effect.summary: Leaving a region can break a lock if the observer loses the opposed check.

stars-without-number.rule.breaking-a-det.cost_or_limit: The ship must leave its region; observers in the destination can immediately try to reacquire it.
stars-without-number.rule.breaking-a-det.combines: Original observer cannot pursue the ship's new region after losing the lock.

stars-without-number.rule.long-range-pur.name: Long-range pursuit

effect.summary: A pursuer with a detection lock can force an engagement or the pursued ship can gain time toward escape.

stars-without-number.rule.long-range-pur.cost_or_limit: Both ships must share a region; spike drive ratings modify the opposed chase and escape time.
stars-without-number.rule.long-range-pur.go_wrong: A pursuer winning or tying forces engagement.
stars-without-number.rule.long-range-pur.combines: A detection lock is required; spike drives affect travel time.

stars-without-number.rule.sensor-scans.name: Sensor scans

effect.summary: Close scans reveal basic ship or planetary information, and successful questioning can extract further details.

stars-without-number.rule.sensor-scans.cost_or_limit: One initial question, difficulty 8; later questions that day grow cumulatively harder.
stars-without-number.rule.sensor-scans.go_wrong: Failed checks make data inconclusive and bar further questions that day.
stars-without-number.rule.sensor-scans.combines: Survey Sensor Array extends orbital observation and information gathering.
stars-without-number.rule.sensor-scans.blocked_reason: The grammar has no way to represent asking questions of sensed data or resolving answers by a skill check.

stars-without-number.rule.spare-parts-st.name: Spare-parts storage

effect.summary: One ton of cargo space holds spare parts worth 10,000 credits.

stars-without-number.rule.spare-parts-st.cost_or_limit: Field repairs take four times as long.

effect.summary: A ship fuel load costs 500 credits.

stars-without-number.rule.six-month-main.name: Six-month maintenance

effect.summary: Ships must spend five percent of non-crew cost each six months to maintain operation.

stars-without-number.rule.six-month-main.cost_or_limit: Skipping a period gives cumulative -1 to ship skill checks and hit rolls; at -4, breakdown risk rises by 10% per month.
stars-without-number.rule.six-month-main.go_wrong: Neglected ships can break down entirely.
stars-without-number.rule.six-month-main.combines: Shipyard maintenance duration depends on hull class.
stars-without-number.rule.six-month-main.blocked_reason: The accumulating penalties and escalating breakdown chance require persistent negative-state tracking.

effect.summary: Routine maintenance takes a day for a fighter, a week for a frigate or cruiser, and a month for a capital ship.

stars-without-number.rule.hull-repair.name: Hull repair

effect.summary: Repairing hull hit points costs 1,000 credits per point, limited by the engineer's Fix skill per day.

stars-without-number.rule.hull-repair.cost_or_limit: Cost and daily repair cap apply.

stars-without-number.rule.jury-rigged-sy.name: Jury-rigged system repair

effect.summary: A disabled system can be temporarily restored for one-tenth its cost, taking one day per 25,000 credits spent.

stars-without-number.rule.jury-rigged-sy.cost_or_limit: A system disabled again after jury-rigging is destroyed.
stars-without-number.rule.jury-rigged-sy.combines: Full repair costs one-quarter of original price.

stars-without-number.rule.full-system-re.name: Full system repair

effect.summary: A disabled system can be fully repaired for one-quarter of its original price.

stars-without-number.rule.full-system-re.combines: Jury-rigging is cheaper but less durable.

stars-without-number.rule.combat-damage-.name: Combat damage and armor

effect.summary: Hits deal damage reduced by armor, while sufficient armor can negate damage and prevent system disablement.

stars-without-number.rule.combat-damage-.cost_or_limit: Weapon armor-piercing quality can cancel armor.
stars-without-number.rule.combat-damage-.go_wrong: A successful targeted hit can disable a system if damage penetrates.
stars-without-number.rule.combat-damage-.combines: Targeted attacks halve damage before armor is applied.

stars-without-number.rule.targeted-syste.name: Targeted system damage

effect.summary: A penetrating targeted hit disables a fitting or weapon, or lowers a drive by one rank.

stars-without-number.rule.targeted-syste.cost_or_limit: Targeted damage is halved before armor; later hits can destroy disabled systems.
stars-without-number.rule.targeted-syste.go_wrong: Drives reduced below drive-0 and repeatedly hit systems are destroyed.
stars-without-number.rule.targeted-syste.combines: Repair actions can restore disabled, but not destroyed, systems during combat.
stars-without-number.rule.targeted-syste.blocked_reason: This requires tracking damage and distinct disabled or destroyed states for ship components.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-destructi.name: Ship destruction

effect.summary: A fighter hull at zero hit points is destroyed; larger ships face an impending explosion unless the engineer succeeds.

stars-without-number.rule.ship-destructi.cost_or_limit: Larger ships explode within 2d6 minutes; a successful difficulty-10 Fix check leaves a burnt-out hulk.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-destructi.go_wrong: A failed check makes the explosion inevitable.
stars-without-number.rule.ship-destructi.who_may: Ships reduced to zero hit points
stars-without-number.rule.ship-destructi.combines: Intact repair supplies may permit temporary jury-rigged operation.

stars-without-number.rule.accepting-a-cr.name: Accepting a crisis

effect.summary: A ship can negate a hit or disabling attack by taking a crisis instead.

stars-without-number.rule.accepting-a-cr.cost_or_limit: Normally one crisis per round; captain actions can add voluntary crises.
stars-without-number.rule.accepting-a-cr.go_wrong: Crises may cause continuing penalties or acute consequences.
stars-without-number.rule.accepting-a-cr.combines: The captain can use Into the Fire or Keep It Together.
stars-without-number.rule.accepting-a-cr.blocked_reason: Crises impose varied persistent penalties and timed consequences that need custom state tracking.

stars-without-number.rule.crisis-resolut.name: Crisis resolution

effect.summary: A successful relevant skill check ends a crisis; failure leaves it unresolved.

stars-without-number.rule.crisis-resolut.cost_or_limit: Usually difficulty 10, adjustable by two; acute crises must be solved by the next turn's end.
stars-without-number.rule.crisis-resolut.go_wrong: Unresolved acute crises cause their stated consequence; continuing ones keep applying their penalty.
stars-without-number.rule.crisis-resolut.combines: Multiple PCs may cooperate or aid the check.
stars-without-number.rule.crisis-resolut.blocked_reason: Crises require different ongoing penalties, deadlines, and consequences beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.rule.initial-spike-.name: Initial spike-drive routes require fresh navigation

effect.summary: An unmapped first transit requires ongoing course corrections to locate a safe current.

stars-without-number.rule.initial-spike-.cost_or_limit: The drive’s protective bubble can fail before the ship reaches its course.
stars-without-number.rule.initial-spike-.go_wrong: A failed bubble destroys the ship.
stars-without-number.rule.initial-spike-.combines: Later ships can use shared course rutters.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-co.name: Spike-drive course rutters grow stale

effect.summary: Routes not regularly travelled become unreliable as metadimensional currents shift.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-co.cost_or_limit: A fallow route needs a newly plotted course.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-co.go_wrong: Old route data can be worse than useless.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drive-co.combines: Regular traffic keeps route changes recorded.

stars-without-number.rule.colonization-b.name: Colonization beyond the Rim was forbidden

effect.summary: The Mandate barred splinter groups and microcultures from settling beyond existing Rim worlds.

stars-without-number.rule.colonization-b.cost_or_limit: The restriction was justified as social harmony and interstellar security.
stars-without-number.rule.colonization-b.go_wrong: Some groups defied the ban and disappeared into the far dark.
stars-without-number.rule.colonization-b.who_may: The Terran Mandate imposed the restriction.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-educat.name: Psychic education requires a living mentor

effect.summary: Recorded instruction cannot teach the required individualized psychic training; a trained active mentor is necessary.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-educat.cost_or_limit: A suitable tutor must know the training protocols and tailor them to the pupil.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-educat.go_wrong: Without mentors, generations may be needed to rebuild training expertise.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-educat.who_may: A trained psychic mentor can teach a new psychic.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-educat.combines: Uses individualized meditation, focus, and mental training.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drives-h.name: Spike drives have a maximum range

effect.summary: Ships must travel from star to star because metadimensional exposure eventually degrades their protective bubble.

stars-without-number.rule.spike-drives-h.cost_or_limit: Range is limited by the corrosive environment.
stars-without-number.rule.spike-drives-h.go_wrong: The bubble degrades fatally if the ship pushes too far.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.name: Psychic burnout from the Scream

effect.summary: A vast metadimensional wave catastrophically burns out psychics across human space.

stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.cost_or_limit: The wave reaches human space in minutes.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.go_wrong: Most psychics die; survivors are incurably mad.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.mind: Causes catastrophic psychic burnout and madness.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.who_may: The Scream affects psychics across human space.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.where_from: The Veil Nebula, according to later reconstruction.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.combines: Disables psychic-dependent technologies such as the Jump Gates.
stars-without-number.rule.psychic-burnou.blocked_reason: The effect acts across interstellar distances and targets psychics throughout a vast region.

stars-without-number.rule.jump-gates-req.name: Jump Gates require psychic operators

effect.summary: Without master psychic teleporters, Jump Gates cannot provide their long-range transit.

stars-without-number.rule.jump-gates-req.cost_or_limit: A gate needs a choir of suitable psychics.
stars-without-number.rule.jump-gates-req.go_wrong: Loss of the operators disables the network.
stars-without-number.rule.jump-gates-req.who_may: Master psychic teleporters operate the gates.
stars-without-number.rule.jump-gates-req.blocked_reason: This rule depends on a power being supplied by operators to a device.

stars-without-number.rule.worlds-can-be-.name: Worlds can be isolated by metadimensional routes

effect.summary: Unfavorable currents and gaps can prevent travel between otherwise nearby stars or sectors.

stars-without-number.rule.worlds-can-be-.cost_or_limit: Some routes require top-grade Mandate drives or narrow bridgepoints.
stars-without-number.rule.worlds-can-be-.go_wrong: A lost bridgepoint can isolate whole regions.
stars-without-number.rule.worlds-can-be-.combines: Drive capability affects which routes are reachable.

stars-without-number.rule.4-hex-spike-dr.name: 4-hex spike-drive gap limit

effect.summary: Systems separated by four or more hexes cannot be reached without pretech spike drives.

stars-without-number.rule.4-hex-spike-dr.cost_or_limit: A gap of four or more hexes requires pretech spike drives; distant clusters need an intermediate world for contact.

stars-without-number.rule.resource-bottl.name: Resource bottlenecks constrain technological development

effect.summary: A world cannot develop or produce technology when essential resources are unavailable.

stars-without-number.rule.resource-bottl.cost_or_limit: Missing bottleneck resources can hold a world at a low tech level.
stars-without-number.rule.resource-bottl.who_may: Applies to worlds and their populations.
stars-without-number.rule.resource-bottl.combines: Knowledge alone cannot replace required production resources.
