stars-without-number.rule.resource-bottl.blocked_reason: The rule can be represented as a restriction on available technology.

stars-without-number.rule.technical-data.name: Technical data does not immediately raise a world's tech level

effect.summary: A world given technical knowledge may still need a generation or longer to establish the infrastructure and resource extraction needed to use it.

stars-without-number.rule.technical-data.cost_or_limit: Advancement can take a generation or more, especially if local cultures resist the technology.
stars-without-number.rule.technical-data.who_may: Applies to worlds receiving technical data.
stars-without-number.rule.technical-data.blocked_reason: This is a time and infrastructure constraint, not an unrepresented effect.

stars-without-number.rule.most-worlds-ca.name: Most worlds cannot readily exceed tech level 4

effect.summary: For most planets, tech level 4 is the practical upper limit of readily attainable expertise.

stars-without-number.rule.most-worlds-ca.cost_or_limit: Higher development is unusual and may take decades or centuries to reach TL4.
stars-without-number.rule.most-worlds-ca.combines: Regular interstellar contact and raw materials encourage development toward TL4.
stars-without-number.rule.most-worlds-ca.blocked_reason: The rule is a straightforward limit on attainable technology.

stars-without-number.rule.pretech-produc.name: Pretech production depends on specially trained industrial psychics

effect.summary: Pretech manufacturing relied on specially trained industrial psychics and their distinctive disciplines.

stars-without-number.rule.pretech-produc.cost_or_limit: Loss of those disciplines sharply reduces production efficiency.
stars-without-number.rule.pretech-produc.go_wrong: Without the lost disciplines, manufacturing is slower and less precise.
stars-without-number.rule.pretech-produc.combines: The Scream caused most worlds to lose access to the unique disciplines.
stars-without-number.rule.pretech-produc.blocked_reason: The passage states a production dependency and its limitation.

stars-without-number.rule.a-tech-level-5.name: A tech level 5 world's industrial output is sharply limited without lost psychic disciplines

effect.summary: Even a TL5 world cannot maintain full pretech industrial output unless it redevelops the lost psychic disciplines.

stars-without-number.rule.a-tech-level-5.cost_or_limit: Most technology remains mass-produced postech; only important goods tend to receive pretech quality.
stars-without-number.rule.a-tech-level-5.who_may: Applies to TL5 worlds that lack the disciplines.
stars-without-number.rule.a-tech-level-5.where_from: The loss of the industrial psychic disciplines during the Scream.
stars-without-number.rule.a-tech-level-5.combines: Redeveloping the disciplines could remove the production bottleneck, though this is described as profoundly unlikely.
stars-without-number.rule.a-tech-level-5.blocked_reason: This is a restriction on production capacity.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-embodiment.name: VI embodiment

effect.summary: VIs are tied to the specific hardware and chassis they were made to operate.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-embodiment.cost_or_limit: A VI cannot be transplanted into another chassis or survive destruction of its body.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-embodiment.blocked_reason: The rule specifies the fate of an embodied mind but the basic grammar cannot represent identity persistence or destruction.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-manufacture.name: VI manufacture

effect.summary: Quantum growth makes VIs more tractable to create than True AIs, but production still fails often.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-manufacture.cost_or_limit: Requires suitable local energy conditions and has frequent failures.

stars-without-number.rule.expert-system-.name: Expert system levels

effect.summary: Higher system levels improve bot durability, danger management, and exception handling while raising base cost.

stars-without-number.rule.expert-system-.cost_or_limit: Level 2 doubles base cost; levels 3 and 4 cost four and eight times base.
stars-without-number.rule.expert-system-.combines: Level adds skill and attack benefits and affects hit dice and saves.

stars-without-number.rule.confusion-chec.name: Confusion check

effect.summary: An expert system outside its programming may behave inappropriately when it fails a check.

stars-without-number.rule.confusion-chec.cost_or_limit: Triggered by a situation beyond the bot’s programming.
stars-without-number.rule.confusion-chec.go_wrong: Failure makes the bot pursue its normal function in an unsuitable way.
stars-without-number.rule.confusion-chec.combines: The check uses the bot’s skill bonus and situation difficulty.
stars-without-number.rule.confusion-chec.blocked_reason: This is a procedure rather than an entity or a world-mechanism rule.

stars-without-number.rule.bot-repair.name: Bot repair

effect.summary: A trained repairer can restore bot hit points using spare parts and work time.

stars-without-number.rule.bot-repair.cost_or_limit: Requires Fix-0, a postech toolkit, one spare-parts unit, and fifteen minutes; repairs hit points equal to system level.
stars-without-number.rule.bot-repair.go_wrong: A bot at zero hit points is destroyed and unsalvageable.
stars-without-number.rule.bot-repair.who_may: A repairer with the stated skill and toolkit.
stars-without-number.rule.bot-repair.combines: Spare parts and expert-system level determine repair amount.

stars-without-number.rule.bot-retreat-pr.name: Bot retreat programming

effect.summary: Most bots are programmed to retreat when destruction appears imminent, though owners can override it.

stars-without-number.rule.bot-retreat-pr.cost_or_limit: Can be overridden by the owner.
stars-without-number.rule.bot-retreat-pr.who_may: Most bots; owners can override it.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-price.name: VI bot price

effect.summary: VI programming costs ten times an equivalent expert-system bot.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-price.who_may: Applies where VIs can be manufactured.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-price.combines: VI wiring has difficulty using high-end expert-system resources.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-repair-.name: VI bot repair and destruction

effect.summary: A VI bot can be overhauled after lesser trauma, but a second disabling loss before overhaul destroys it.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-repair-.cost_or_limit: A Fix-0 technician needs 24 hours for overhaul; field repair can use spare parts at ordinary-bot rates.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-repair-.go_wrong: Zero HP again before overhaul means the VI perishes; complete ruin also defeats repair.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-repair-.who_may: A technician with Fix-0 can overhaul it.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-bot-repair-.combines: Field jury-rigging can temporarily restore operation.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-growth.name: VI growth

effect.summary: Most VIs do not develop, but a few can acquire skills and change through experience.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-growth.cost_or_limit: Growth is unusual; even clever VIs lack True AI potential.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-growth.go_wrong: Clever VIs may evade some behavioral restrictions.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-growth.mind: Usually static; rare individuals grow like humans.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-growth.combines: Behavioral imperatives and curbs can still affect clever VIs.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-growth.blocked_reason: The passage links development and evasion to persistent mental constraints that the basic effect grammar cannot represent.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-trauma-thre.name: VI trauma threshold

effect.summary: Some worlds treat clever VIs as free citizens; others may scrap those that leave their owners.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-trauma-thre.go_wrong: A wandering clever VI may be scrapped in some places.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-trauma-thre.mind: Clever VIs can think around some limits.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-trauma-thre.who_may: World authorities and societies determine treatment.

stars-without-number.rule.clever-vi-stat.name: Clever VI status

effect.summary: A clever VI’s legal freedom or treatment as property varies among worlds.

stars-without-number.rule.clever-vi-stat.cost_or_limit: Depends on local law and custom.
stars-without-number.rule.clever-vi-stat.go_wrong: Some worlds treat wandering clever VIs as nuisances to destroy.

stars-without-number.rule.beast-swarm.name: Beast swarm

effect.summary: A swarm has four times the base animal’s hit dice, and a missed attack still causes minimum damage unless the target is immune.

stars-without-number.rule.beast-swarm.cost_or_limit: Attacks that are ineffective against the swarm do not help; useful attacks automatically hit.
stars-without-number.rule.beast-swarm.combines: The attack and damage follow the underlying animal type.

stars-without-number.rule.predator-moral.name: Predator morale

effect.summary: A sane predator generally avoids fighting to the death and checks morale when prey first harms it.

stars-without-number.rule.predator-moral.cost_or_limit: Maddened or cornered predators may fight to the death.
stars-without-number.rule.predator-moral.mind: Predators avoid risking injury while hunting.
stars-without-number.rule.predator-moral.combines: Adds a morale check on top of usual checks.

stars-without-number.rule.poison-onset-a.name: Poison onset and duration

effect.summary: Poisons can take effect after a delay and last for a separate duration, with outcomes including death, paralysis, injury, convulsions, blindness, or hallucinations.

stars-without-number.rule.poison-onset-a.cost_or_limit: Victims can usually attempt a Physical save; treatment may use a medkit or antidote stim.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-onset-a.go_wrong: A failed resistance may cause incapacitation or other listed effects.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-onset-a.who_may: Creatures may carry poisons; victims may resist or seek treatment.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-onset-a.combines: A medic without a specific antidote can attempt one Heal check.
stars-without-number.rule.poison-onset-a.blocked_reason: The many poison outcomes and variable onset and duration are not expressible as one basic effect.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-player-char.name: VI player-character eligibility

effect.summary: A VI character is made by spending the free focus choice on a one-level origin, usually during character creation.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-player-char.cost_or_limit: Normally only available at character creation; a converted full-conversion cyborg may exceptionally gain it later.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-player-char.who_may: Players, if the GM allows VI characters.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-player-char.combines: The origin focus grants a VI form.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-player-char.blocked_reason: This is a character-generation procedure, not a world mechanism.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-limitati.name: VI PC limitations

effect.summary: VIs use human character attributes and classes, but cannot be Psychics or take the Partial Psychic option.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-limitati.cost_or_limit: Uses ordinary character creation and starts at first level.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-limitati.combines: A VI’s personal statistics replace the listed statistics for its bot type.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-operating-n.name: VI operating needs and immunities

effect.summary: VIs need neither sleep, food, nor drink, but require a Type B cell each week away from available current.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-operating-n.cost_or_limit: Radiation degrades them like humans; ordinary toxins do not poison or infect them.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-operating-n.combines: Immune to vacuum and normal poisoning or disease.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-healing.name: VI PC healing

effect.summary: Spare parts heal a VI by an amount equal to its character level per unit, taking fifteen minutes.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-healing.cost_or_limit: Requires spare parts; another person needs Fix-0, but a VI can repair itself.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-healing.go_wrong: VIs normally cannot benefit from biopsionic healing.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-healing.who_may: A VI itself or someone with Fix-0.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-pc-healing.combines: One part unit and fifteen minutes per repair increment.

stars-without-number.rule.badly-damaged-.name: Badly Damaged VI

effect.summary: A VI at zero HP without being smashed is incapacitated; overhaul removes this condition, while another zero-HP event risks permanent destruction.

stars-without-number.rule.badly-damaged-.cost_or_limit: Overhaul requires 24 hours, a technician, and one spare-parts unit; field jury-rigging is possible.
stars-without-number.rule.badly-damaged-.go_wrong: A VI reduced to zero HP again while Badly Damaged must save or be permanently destroyed.
stars-without-number.rule.badly-damaged-.who_may: A technician can perform the overhaul or field repair.
stars-without-number.rule.badly-damaged-.combines: Field repair uses ordinary spare-part healing rates.
stars-without-number.rule.badly-damaged-.blocked_reason: The persistent Badly Damaged state and its conditional destruction require state tracking beyond the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-chassis-and.name: VI chassis and grafted equipment

effect.summary: VIs cannot change bodies, but equipment can be integrated into their chassis.

stars-without-number.rule.vi-chassis-and.cost_or_limit: Integrated gear costs twice stand-alone price, takes a week, and is capped at half Constitution in encumbrance points; cyberware is unusable.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-chassis-and.go_wrong: Grafted gear may need its own power or ammunition.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-chassis-and.combines: Equipment may have separate power and ammunition supplies.
stars-without-number.rule.vi-chassis-and.blocked_reason: The rule binds equipment to a body and limits its capacity, which is not represented by the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.rule.beast-creation.name: Beast creation templates

effect.summary: Creature tables provide guidelines for designing beasts and their appearance, behavior, and capabilities.

stars-without-number.rule.beast-creation.cost_or_limit: The creator chooses or rolls features to fit the adventure.
stars-without-number.rule.beast-creation.combines: Feature and behavior tables can be mixed.
stars-without-number.rule.beast-creation.blocked_reason: This is game-design procedure, not a world-mechanism rule.

stars-without-number.rule.alien-species-.name: Alien species lenses

effect.summary: One or two strong emotional or social traits can shape a Like species’ society and behavior.

stars-without-number.rule.alien-species-.cost_or_limit: Lenses are guidelines rather than exhaustive accounts of a species.
stars-without-number.rule.alien-species-.mind: Influences species-wide social and emotional tendencies.
stars-without-number.rule.alien-species-.combines: Multiple lenses can be selected or invented.

stars-without-number.rule.alien-origin-f.name: Alien origin focus benefits

effect.summary: An alien origin generally grants two listed benefits, or three if some are minor.

stars-without-number.rule.alien-origin-f.cost_or_limit: A player spends their initial focus pick to select the alien origin.
stars-without-number.rule.alien-origin-f.who_may: Player characters whose GM permits alien characters.
stars-without-number.rule.alien-origin-f.combines: Benefits can be chosen to suit the species.
stars-without-number.rule.alien-origin-f.blocked_reason: This is a character-building restriction and benefit allocation rule.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.name: Faction homeworld access

effect.summary: A faction may buy assets and act on its homeworld without other assets there; enemies may attack there if they can move assets in.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.cost_or_limit: Enemy attacks still require assets to reach the homeworld.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.combines: Uses asset movement and location rules.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.blocked_reason: This is a straightforward restriction on faction actions by location.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-support-.name: Asset support rating

effect.summary: An asset requires sufficient faction ratings for effective support.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-support-.cost_or_limit: A faction cannot ordinarily own more assets of a type than its relevant rating; each excess asset costs one extra FacCred in maintenance each turn.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-support-.go_wrong: Unsupported over-cap assets carry added ongoing cost.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-support-.combines: Rating limits interact with FacCred maintenance.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-support-.blocked_reason: The limits and resource costs can be tracked directly.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-maintena.name: Asset maintenance and loss

effect.summary: An unpaid asset becomes unusable, then is lost if it goes two consecutive turns without maintenance.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-maintena.cost_or_limit: Maintenance is due each turn and cannot be voluntarily skipped.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-maintena.go_wrong: Failure to pay disables and eventually removes the asset.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-maintena.mechanism: Upkeep, temporary unavailability, and delayed loss.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-maintena.blocked_reason: The rule is a simple turn-based cost and loss condition.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-location.name: Asset location restriction

effect.summary: Assets cannot act against a different location until transported there.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-location.cost_or_limit: Transport generally requires a logistical asset.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-location.blocked_reason: The rule can be applied as a location prerequisite.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-technolo.name: Asset technology requirement

effect.summary: An asset must be purchased on a world with enough technology, though it can later be transported to a lower-tech world.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-technolo.cost_or_limit: Purchase requires the relevant local technology level.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-technolo.combines: Can be followed by asset transport.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-technolo.blocked_reason: The purchase restriction is directly represented by a tech-level check.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-turn-a.name: Faction turn action limit

effect.summary: A faction usually takes one type of action per turn, though it may apply that action on multiple worlds or with multiple assets.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-turn-a.cost_or_limit: Usually one action type per turn; PC adventures are outside this economy.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-turn-a.combines: Multiple assets may contribute to the chosen action.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-turn-a.blocked_reason: The rule is a simple per-turn action limit.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-income.name: Faction income

effect.summary: At each turn’s start, a faction gains FacCreds based on Wealth, Force, and Cunning.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-income.cost_or_limit: Income is half Wealth rounded up plus one-quarter of total Force and Cunning rounded down.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-income.combines: Income is used for maintenance and faction operations.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-income.blocked_reason: This is a calculable recurring resource rule.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-a.name: Faction goal abandonment

effect.summary: Abandoning an existing goal costs the faction its turn’s FacCred income and prevents any other action that turn.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-a.cost_or_limit: The penalty consumes the turn’s income and action.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-a.combines: Can choose a new goal if none is active.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-a.blocked_reason: The restriction is a straightforward turn and resource cost.

stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.name: Attack targeting and resolution

effect.summary: Faction attacks use opposed rolls to damage a defending asset or, in some cases, the defender’s base and faction hit points.

stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.cost_or_limit: Only known enemy assets on the same world may be targeted; each attacking asset attacks once per turn.
stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.go_wrong: A failed attack may trigger the defender’s counterattack; ties cause both sides to deal damage.
stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.who_may: Factions with assets that have an Attack entry.
stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.combines: Uses Attack and Counterattack entries and relevant faction ratings.
stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.mechanism: Opposed rolls, damage, and asset loss.
stars-without-number.rule.attack-targeti.blocked_reason: The procedure uses ordinary opposed checks and hit-point damage.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.name: Asset purchase delay

effect.summary: A newly purchased asset cannot attack, defend, or grant benefits until the faction’s next turn.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.cost_or_limit: Only one asset may be purchased per faction turn.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.combines: Requires sufficient faction rating and local technology.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.mechanism: Delayed asset activation and purchase limit.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.blocked_reason: The restriction is a turn-based delay and quantity limit.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.name: Faction homeworld change time

effect.summary: Changing homeworld takes one turn plus one additional turn per hex of distance, during which the faction cannot act.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.cost_or_limit: The faction needs a Base of Influence at the destination.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.go_wrong: The faction loses action opportunities during the move.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.combines: Depends on map distance and Bases of Influence.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.blocked_reason: The rule is a timed action restriction.

stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.name: Expand Influence contest

effect.summary: A faction may buy a Base of Influence where it already has an asset, but rival factions may immediately attack it after contested rolls.

stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.cost_or_limit: The new base cannot be used until the next turn; its cost is one FacCred per hit point, up to the faction’s maximum hit points.
stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.go_wrong: Rivals that match or beat the purchaser’s roll may make a free immediate attack.
stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.who_may: Factions with at least one asset on the planet.
stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.combines: Other assets can defend the new base normally.
stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.mechanism: Base purchase, contested roll, and immediate counteraction.
stars-without-number.rule.expand-influen.blocked_reason: The rule can be resolved using faction rolls, asset hit points, and FacCreds.

stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.name: Base of Influence hit-point adjustment

effect.summary: A faction can pay to add hit points to a Base of Influence or reduce them without a refund.

stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.cost_or_limit: Each added hit point costs one FacCred; a homeworld base cannot be reduced this way.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.go_wrong: Reducing hit points yields no refund.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.who_may: Factions that own a Base of Influence.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.combines: The base cannot exceed the faction’s maximum hit points.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct resource-for-hit-points exchange with a stated exception.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-refit-de.name: Asset refit delay

effect.summary: A faction can convert one asset into another of the same type, but it cannot attack or defend until the next turn.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-refit-de.cost_or_limit: Pay any price difference; the world must support the new asset’s technology level.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-refit-de.go_wrong: The refitted asset is temporarily unavailable for attack and defense.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-refit-de.combines: The new asset must be of the same type.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-refit-de.mechanism: Asset conversion, cost difference, and delayed activation.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-refit-de.blocked_reason: The rule is an asset state change with a turn-based delay.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-repair.name: Asset repair

effect.summary: Repairs asset or faction damage for FacCreds.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-repair.cost_or_limit: Asset repair costs rise with each additional amount repaired; faction healing cannot be hurried.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-repair.blocked_reason: Damage and resource costs fit the basic effect grammar.

stars-without-number.rule.seize-planet.name: Seize Planet

effect.summary: Successful seizure makes the faction the world’s ruling body.

stars-without-number.rule.seize-planet.cost_or_limit: Destroy opposing unstealthed assets, then maintain one unstealthed asset for three turns; no other actions during the attempt.
stars-without-number.rule.seize-planet.go_wrong: The attempt fails if the faction’s assets are destroyed or leave before completion.
stars-without-number.rule.seize-planet.blocked_reason: The success conditions can be represented with ordinary state and timing rules.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-merger.name: Faction merger compatibility

effect.summary: A compatibility check determines merger outcomes.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-merger.cost_or_limit: Roll 1d10 against a compatibility rating; success is equal or lower.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-merger.go_wrong: Failed checks produce less favorable outcomes, including asset sale.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-merger.combines: Ratings, assets, credits, bases, and goals are resolved separately.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-merger.blocked_reason: A check and its outcomes are straightforward to model.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.name: Asset purchase restrictions

effect.summary: Purchases require suitable technology and sometimes government permission.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.cost_or_limit: One purchase per faction per turn; the new asset cannot act or provide benefits until the buyer’s next turn.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.go_wrong: Government forces can disrupt restricted recruitment or entry.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.combines: Base of Influence and tech level determine availability.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-purchase.blocked_reason: Purchase restrictions and delayed use fit ordinary game rules.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-special-.name: Asset special-action order

effect.summary: Each asset form’s abilities resolve together in sequence.

stars-without-number.rule.asset-special-.cost_or_limit: Targets generally must share a stellar system with the acting assets.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-special-.combines: Different asset forms resolve in a set order.
stars-without-number.rule.asset-special-.blocked_reason: The rule is ordinary turn sequencing.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-versus.name: Faction versus faction test

effect.summary: Compare attribute-modified d10 rolls; higher wins.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-versus.cost_or_limit: Use the highest die when tags grant extra dice.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-versus.go_wrong: A failed test does not succeed; tests are not attacks and cause no damage or counterattack.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-versus.blocked_reason: The check is directly executable as a game procedure.

stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.name: Base of Influence restrictions

effect.summary: Bases limit where assets can be bought and cannot be moved.

stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.cost_or_limit: Only one per world; bought only with Expand Influence; sale value zero; excluded from maximum assets.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.go_wrong: Damage also reduces faction hit points; damage below zero does not overflow to faction hit points.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.combines: Homeworld automatically has a maximum-hit-point base.
stars-without-number.rule.base-of-influe.blocked_reason: The restrictions and linked damage can be represented in game state.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.name: Faction homeworld base

effect.summary: A faction’s homeworld has a full-strength Base of Influence.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.cost_or_limit: Moving the homeworld resets the destination base to maximum hit points and swaps in its former value for the old homeworld base.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.mechanism: automatic starting asset and state transfer
stars-without-number.rule.faction-homewo.blocked_reason: Base hit points can be tracked and reassigned.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-l.name: Faction goal limits

effect.summary: A faction pursues only one goal at a time.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-l.cost_or_limit: Abandoning a goal forfeits that turn’s FacCred income and action.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-l.go_wrong: Abandonment wastes preparations and demoralizes the faction.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-goal-l.blocked_reason: Goal tracking and resource loss fit ordinary game procedures.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-attrib.name: Faction attribute advancement

effect.summary: Experience raises faction attributes and maximum hit points.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-attrib.cost_or_limit: Attribute increases consume experience, with costs rising by rating.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-attrib.combines: Force, Cunning, and Wealth determine maximum hit points.
stars-without-number.rule.faction-attrib.blocked_reason: Ratings, experience, and hit points are standard tracked values.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-donati.name: Faction donation processing limit

effect.summary: A faction can receive up to 1d4 × 100,000 credits in a turn, at one FacCred per 100,000; excess is wasted and processing takes a full turn.

stars-without-number.rule.faction-donati.go_wrong: Excess donations are lost to accounting inefficiency.

stars-without-number.rule.no-interstella.name: No interstellar bulk shipping

effect.summary: Interstellar commerce cannot practically carry bulk commodities.

stars-without-number.rule.no-interstella.cost_or_limit: Even the largest spike-drive ships carry only tens of thousands of tons; the failure of the Jump Gates ended system-ship freight between worlds.
stars-without-number.rule.no-interstella.combines: Trade instead focuses on small loads of valuable goods and services.
